Abstract: Recent Video Super-Resolution (VSR) methods rely heavily on transformers and explicit optical flow, creating computational overhead and custom operations that hinder deployment on hardware accelerators like TensorRT. To address this, we introduce NanoVSR, a scalable, fully convolutional architecture designed for resource-constrained edge devices. Using structural reparameterization, NanoVSR collapses into standard convolutions during inference, ensuring seamless hardware compatibility and negligible runtime overhead. Furthermore, despite lacking explicit motion compensation, it maintains competitive restoration quality by implicitly learning spatio-temporal alignments through progressive training. Evaluated on the REDS4 benchmark, NanoVSR demonstrates an exceptional balance between accuracy and computational efficiency, significantly improving the trade-off for compact architectures. Our NanoVSR-644k baseline yields 28.64 dB PSNR while delivering 27.2 FPS on the NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16GB (25W), offering massive speed gains over heavier models. The scaled NanoVSR-1.7M variant reaches 29.15 dB with a throughput of 19.58 FPS, providing superior, edge-optimized upscaling. Code is available at https://github.com/filippawlicki/nanovsr.

</details>


### [68] [Towards Autonomous and Auditable Medical Imaging Model Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10522)
*Shengyuan Liu,Jia-Xuan Jiang,Boyun Zheng,Cheng Wang,Zipei Wang,Wentao Pan,Hongtao Wu,Houwen Peng,Yu Gu,Lichao Sun,Yixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AMID是一个面向医学影像模型开发的自主多智能体框架，通过数据条件化方法规划和验证引导的两阶段优化，在20项医学影像挑战任务中超越通用MLE系统，部分任务接近甚至匹敌人类设计的解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体开始自动化机器学习工程，但将其能力迁移到医学影像领域仍然困难，因为每个任务都涉及模态特定的实验、严格的验证协议和预测工件要求。

Method: 提出Data-Conditioned Method Planning（基于任务数据分析和可运行的医学影像资源，将粗粒度搜索空间细化为可执行、可并行的方法通道）和Verification-Guided Two-Stage Optimization（前期广泛探索多样化方法通道，后期选择性开发有潜力的候选方案，并全程严格验证验证协议、指标计算和预测工件）。

Result: 在涵盖多种模态和预测类型的20项医学影像挑战任务中，AMID超越了评估的通用MLE系统，并在多项任务上接近或匹敌优秀的人工设计解决方案。

Conclusion: AMID能够将医学影像模型开发从定制化手工工程转变为自主化工作流，在异构任务中生成高性能且可审计的模型工件。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to automate machine learning engineering (MLE) by coupling planning, code execution, debugging, and empirical feedback. Translating this capability to medical imaging remains difficult because each task imposes modality-specific experimentation and strict requirements for validation protocols and prediction artifacts. Here we introduce AMID, an autonomous multi-agent framework for medical imaging model development. AMID first proposes Data-Conditioned Method Planning, which refines coarse task-level search spaces into executable, parallelizable method lanes grounded in task-specific data analysis and runnable medical-imaging resources. It then develops Verification-Guided Two-Stage Optimization, moving from broad early exploration of diverse method lanes to selective exploitation of promising candidates while enforcing strict verification of validation protocols, metric computation, and prediction artifacts throughout the optimization. Across 20 medical imaging challenge tasks spanning diverse modalities and prediction types, AMID outperformed evaluated general-purpose MLE systems and, on several tasks, approached or matched strong human-designed challenge solutions. These results suggest that AMID can turn task-specific medical imaging model development from bespoke manual engineering into an agentic workflow for producing high-performing and auditable model artifacts across heterogeneous tasks.

</details>


### [69] [Improving Sample Diversity in Autoregressive Text-to-Image Generation via Cluster Truncation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10535)
*Trang Nguyen,Shuang Wu,Runyan Tan,Phillip Howard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了自回归文本到图像生成模型的样本多样性问题，发现其高熵和视觉标记冗余限制了现有解码策略的有效性，并提出了一种新的聚类级截断采样策略——p-less cluster，在保持图像质量和提示对齐的同时显著提升了多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在T2I生成中面临样本多样性坍塌问题，而自回归模型在质量与效率上取得进展，但其多样性-质量权衡尚未被系统研究。本文旨在探索AR模型是否能推动图像质量与样本多样性的帕累托前沿。

Method: 首先系统研究AR图像生成模型的多样性特性，发现两个关键性质：持续高token级熵和视觉token空间的高度冗余。基于此，提出p-less cluster解码策略，在聚类级别而非token级别执行基于熵的截断采样。

Result: 在四个自回归T2I模型和两个数据集上评估，p-less cluster在大多数模型和数据集中实现了最大的多样性提升，同时保持了图像质量和提示对齐。

Conclusion: p-less cluster策略有效解决了AR模型中token级多样性增强方法的局限性，为自回归图像生成模型提供了更好的多样性-质量权衡。

Abstract: While diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art image quality for text-to-image (T2I) generation, recent work has demonstrated that they suffer from sample diversity collapse. In this work, we investigate whether autoregressive (AR) image generation models can push the Pareto frontier between image quality and sample diversity. With recent advances in quality and efficiency, AR models have emerged as a viable alternative to diffusion-based image generation. Beyond enabling new use cases such as interleaved image-text generation, their sequential generation process makes them compatible with a wide range of token-based decoding strategies originally developed to improve diversity in text generation. Motivated by the potential of a better diversity-quality tradeoff in the AR paradigm, we present the first systematic study of sample diversity in AR image generation models. We show that two key properties of AR image generation, persistently high token-level entropy and substantial redundancy in visual token spaces, limit the effectiveness of existing token-level decoding methods for diversity enhancement. We therefore propose $p$-less cluster, a new decoding strategy that performs entropy-based truncation sampling at cluster level rather than at token level. We evaluate our approach and baseline decoding methods across four autoregressive T2I models and two datasets using a comprehensive suite of metrics spanning image quality, prompt alignment, and diversity. Our results show that $p$-less cluster unlocks the greatest diversity across most evaluated autoregressive T2I models and datasets while maintaining image quality and prompt alignment.

</details>


### [70] [Physics-inspired Pseudo Anomaly Generation and Prototype Feature Guidance for 3D Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10544)
*Jian Ning,Qin Zou,Linchun Wu,Yuanhao Yue,Kunmo Li,Shoubin Chen,Zhongyuan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PA3AD框架，通过物理启发的伪异常生成策略和原型特征引导机制，解决了3D点云异常检测中真实异常样本稀缺的问题，在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD数据集上达到了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D点云异常检测在工业制造中至关重要，但面临真实异常样本稀缺且获取成本高的挑战，且训练数据天然不含异常，导致模型难以有效学习正常与异常之间的判别性特征。

Method: 提出PA3AD框架，包含两个关键创新：(1) 物理启发的伪异常生成模块，通过多物理场建模从正常数据生成多样化的物理合理的伪异常点云；(2) 动量更新的原型特征和差异感知融合模块，捕获稳定的正常表示及其与伪异常之间的差异，从而学习分布偏移。

Result: 在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: PA3AD通过物理启发的伪异常生成和原型特征引导，有效缓解了真实异常样本稀缺问题，显著提升了3D点云异常检测性能。

Abstract: 3D point cloud anomaly detection plays a vital role in industrial manufacturing, yet it faces significant challenges due to the scarcity and high acquisition cost of real anomalous samples. The inherently anomaly-free training data further hinders detection methods from effectively learning discriminative features between normal and abnormal instances. To address these issues, we propose PA3AD, a novel framework that introduces a physics-inspired pseudo-anomaly generation strategy to create physically plausible anomalous samples from normal data. Additionally, we incorporate prototype features via a weight-sharing mechanism to guide the model in capturing the distribution shifts between normal and anomalous samples. Specifically, PA3AD introduces two key innovations to tackle the scarcity of real anomalies. First, a physics-inspired module generates diverse pseudo-anomalous point clouds from normal data via multi-physics modeling. Second, momentum-updated prototypes and a difference-aware fusion block capture stable normal representations and their discrepancies with pseudo-anomalies. This design effectively learns distribution shifts, achieving superior detection performance. Extensive experiments on the Anomaly-ShapeNet and Real3D-AD datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches. Our code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/NingxiaoJian/PA3AD.

</details>


### [71] [Quantum Compressed Sensing CT Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Penalized Weighted Least Squares and Guided Total Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10566)
*Yuwen Zhang,Yujie Liu,Ao Wang,Yikuang Yuluo,Shuangyang Zhong,Haijun Yu,Yixing Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于QUBO的量子压缩感知CT重建方法（PWLS-GTV），该方法将光子计数统计加权（PWLS）和引导全变分正则化（GTV）融入QUBO框架，在不改变二次型形式的前提下，显著提升了稀疏视角CT重建质量（胸部案例PSNR达36.64 dB，远超SART的22.48 dB），为量子辅助CT重建提供了概念验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于QUBO的稀疏视角CT重建忽略了光子计数统计特性和解剖异质性，导致重建质量受限。本文旨在将这两方面因素纳入QUBO框架，以提升重建精度。

Method: 提出PWLS-GTV方法：PWLS项根据光子计数可靠性对投影残差加权，GTV项利用SART重建的先验图像梯度引导边缘保持和均匀区域噪声抑制。两项经二进制编码后形成统一的QUBO模型。实验采用4张40×40 CT图像、10视角扇束几何、含泊松噪声，对比了传统方法、QUBO变体、梯度下降、模拟退火及D-Wave混合量子-经典求解器。

Result: PWLS-GTV在所有案例中重建质量最佳。胸部案例PSNR达36.64 dB，传统最优基线SART仅22.48 dB。GTV优于传统全变分。模拟退火与D-Wave混合求解器结果相似，梯度下降效果差。混合求解器多次运行性能稳定。

Conclusion: 该框架成功将光子统计加权和结构引导正则化融入QUBO基CT重建，且不改变二次型形式，为量子辅助稀疏视角CT重建提供了概念验证。

Abstract: Objective. Existing quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO)-based sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reconstruction neglects photon-counting statistics and anatomical heterogeneity. We address both limitations within the QUBO framework.Approach. We propose a quantum compressed-sensing CT method combining penalized weighted least squares (PWLS) and guided total variation (GTV). PWLS weights projection residuals by photon-count reliability, whereas GTV uses gradients from a prior image reconstructed by the simultaneous algebraic reconstruction technique (SART) to preserve edges and suppress noise in homogeneous regions. After binary encoding, both terms form a unified QUBO model. Experiments used four 40 times 40 CT images under a 10-view fan-beam geometry with Poisson noise. Comparisons included conventional reconstruction methods, QUBO variants, gradient descent, simulated annealing, and a D-Wave hybrid quantum-classical solver.Main results. PWLS-GTV achieved the best reconstruction quality across all cases. In the representative chest case, it reached a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 36.64 dB, compared with 22.48 dB for SART, the best conventional baseline. GTV consistently outperformed conventional total variation. Simulated annealing and the D-Wave hybrid solver produced similar reconstructions, whereas gradient descent was ineffective. Repeated hybrid-solver runs showed stable performance.Significance. The framework incorporates photon-statistical weighting and structure-guided regularization into QUBO-based CT reconstruction without changing its quadratic form, providing a proof of concept for quantum-assisted sparse-view CT reconstruction.

</details>


### [72] [Why Domain Matters: Domain-Aware Benchmarking of Underwater Object Detection and Annotation Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10575)
*Melanie Wille,Dimity Miller,Tobias Fischer,Scarlett Raine*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个物理意义驱动的领域标注框架，系统研究了水下目标检测中领域偏移对人工标注质量和检测器性能的影响，揭示了显著的领域依赖差异，并展示了如何利用该框架指导数据收集、设计更有信息量的基准测试以及评估检测器鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水下目标检测评估使用聚合指标掩盖了特定环境下的失败，而领域泛化基准多依赖不反映真实条件的合成变化，缺乏对真实水下领域偏移的系统性研究。

Method: 提出一个新的框架，通过外观、场景构成和采集几何三个维度对水下图像进行领域标签标注；基于该框架首次系统研究领域因素对人工标注质量和深度学习检测器性能的影响。

Result: 发现水下目标检测中领域因素会导致人工标注质量和检测器性能出现显著的领域依赖差异。

Conclusion: 通过引入物理意义的领域标签，领域偏移变得可描述、可测量、可基准测试和可干预；该框架可用于指导数据收集与标注、设计更信息丰富的基准、评估检测器在不同水下环境中的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Underwater object detection is strongly affected by domain shift, where performance can vary significantly across different locations, habitats, and deployment conditions. However, detector performance is typically evaluated using aggregate metrics that hide failures in specific environments, while existing domain generalization benchmarks often rely on synthetic variations that do not reflect real-world conditions. We introduce a framework that characterizes underwater images by appearance, scene composition, and acquisition geometry to assign domain labels. Using this framework, we perform the first systematic study of how domain factors influence both human annotation quality in underwater object detection datasets and deep learning-based detector performance, revealing substantial domain-dependent discrepancies. By incorporating physically meaningful domain labels, domain shift becomes something we can characterize, measure, benchmark, and act on. We highlight how this can be used to guide data collection and annotation, design more informative benchmarks, and assess detector robustness across diverse underwater environments.

</details>


### [73] [DiffUE: Enhancing Utility-Unlearnability Trade-off of Unlearnable Examples via Diffusion Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10580)
*Syed Irfan Ali Meerza,Oktay Ozturk,Amir Sadovnik,Jian Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiffUE提出了一种通过在语义空间而非像素空间注入噪声来生成不可学习样本的方法，利用扩散自编码器框架操作高层语义特征，在保持图像视觉质量的同时实现鲁棒的不可学习性，有效抵抗多种重学习攻击策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有UE方法主要依赖像素级噪声，容易被对抗训练、图像变换和压缩等重学习策略绕过；而提升鲁棒性的方法又会导致图像效用和感知质量显著下降，亟需一种既能保证不可学习性又能维持视觉质量的新方法。

Method: DiffUE采用基于扩散的自编码器框架，通过将噪声注入到图像的语义空间（而非像素空间）来修改高层语义特征，从而生成具有自然外观且能够抵抗高级重学习策略的不可学习样本。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CelebA-HQ和ImageNet四个数据集上的大量实验以及主观用户研究均表明，DiffUE显著提升了图像质量与不可学习性之间的权衡效果。

Conclusion: DiffUE通过语义空间噪声注入为保护个人数据免受AI模型未经授权利用提供了一种更鲁棒且更有效的解决方案，在日益具有剥削性的AI环境中具有重要意义。

Abstract: AI models are increasingly trained on personal images scraped from social media and public platforms, often without consent, leading to serious privacy violations, such as unauthorized facial recognition and targeted advertising. To counter this, researchers have developed unlearnable examples (UEs), images modified with imperceptible noise to prevent AI models from extracting meaningful information. However, existing UE methods primarily rely on pixel-space noise, which can be bypassed by relearning strategies such as adversarial training, image transformation, and compression. While some techniques improve robustness, they often come at the expense of significant degradation in image utility and perceptual quality. In this paper, we introduce DiffUE to overcome these limitations by injecting noise into the semantic space of images instead of the pixel space. Instead of corrupting pixel values, DiffUE modifies high-level semantic features of images, ensuring robust unlearnability while preserving visual quality and utility. By leveraging a diffusion-based autoencoder framework to manipulate semantic features, DiffUE generates purposeful, natural-looking modifications that effectively resist advanced relearning strategies. Extensive experiments on four datasets, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, CelebA-HQ, and ImageNet, as well as a subjective user study, demonstrate that DiffUE significantly enhances the trade-off between image quality and unlearnability, offering a more robust and effective solution for safeguarding personal data in an increasingly exploitative AI landscape.

</details>


### [74] [Benchmarking UAV-based Vehicle Re-Identification under Simulated Weather Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10583)
*Vu Minh Tran,Khang Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对无人机视角下车辆再识别（ReID）在恶劣天气下的鲁棒性进行了系统性研究。通过对三种代表性方法（CLIP-ReID、MSINet、AdaSP）在VRU和UAV-VeID两个基准数据集上进行雾天和雨天的合成退化实验，发现恶劣天气（尤其是雨天）会显著降低检索性能，其中AdaSP表现出最强的鲁棒性。研究揭示了现有方法在天气鲁棒性上的差异，呼吁未来研究关注天气感知的模型设计与评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机车辆ReID研究主要关注干净天气条件下的性能，对恶劣天气（如雾、雨）下方法鲁棒性的系统评估尚属空白。由于天气退化会严重影响航拍图像中细粒度外观线索，而无人机视角又存在目标尺度小、视角变化大、背景复杂等挑战，因此亟需对现有方法在恶劣天气下的鲁棒性进行系统评测，以推动该领域向实际应用场景迈进。

Method: 选取三种代表性车辆ReID方法（CLIP-ReID、MSINet、AdaSP）作为评测对象；采用分析性天气效应渲染管道生成VRU和UAV-VeID两个数据集的合成雾天和雨天变体，同时保留原始身份标签和数据划分；所有方法分别在匹配的干净、雾天、雨天条件下进行训练和评估，实现控制变量对比。

Result: 恶劣天气在所有设置下均显著降低检索性能，雨天带来的性能下降普遍大于雾天。AdaSP鲁棒性最强：在VRU-Large上雾天mAP为93.0%、雨天为88.5%；在UAV-VeID-Test上雾天mAP为88.7%、雨天为76.2%。不同方法在天气鲁棒性上表现出明显差异。

Conclusion: 模拟恶劣天气显著增加了无人机车辆ReID的难度，揭示了现有代表性方法之间鲁棒性的显著差异，表明未来无人机ReID研究亟需引入天气感知的模型设计与评估协议。代码已开源。

Abstract: UAV-based vehicle re-identification (ReID) has emerged as a promising technique for traffic surveillance, urban monitoring, and public-safety applications thanks to the flexible viewpoints and wide-area coverage provided by unmanned aerial vehicles. However, despite recent progress on UAV-based vehicle ReID benchmarks, the robustness of existing methods under adverse weather remains insufficiently studied. This is important because weather degradation can significantly affect the fine-grained appearance cues required for reliable vehicle matching in aerial imagery, especially under small object scale, viewpoint variation, and complex backgrounds. In this paper, we present a controlled comparative study of three representative recent vehicle ReID methods, namely CLIP-ReID, MSINet, and AdaSP, on two UAV-based benchmarks, VRU and UAV-VeID. To ensure consistent robustness evaluation, we generate synthetic foggy and rainy variants of both datasets using an analytical weather-effect pipeline while preserving the original identities and data splits. All methods are then trained and evaluated under matched clean, foggy, and rainy conditions. Experimental results show that adverse weather consistently degrades retrieval performance across both datasets, with rain causing larger drops than fog in nearly all settings. Among the evaluated methods, AdaSP demonstrates the strongest robustness, achieving 93.0% and 88.5% mAP on VRU-Large, and 88.7% and 76.2% mAP on UAV-VeID-Test under foggy and rainy conditions, respectively. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学图像翻译方法存在模态纠缠、过度平滑和伪影问题，根源在于潜空间平均速度场的隐式低通调制导致高频细节丢失。

Method: 将医学图像翻译重构为潜空间中的随机布朗桥过程，通过预测支持正则化平均速度场直接构建源-目标模态映射；引入Spectral Consistency Corrector，利用可学习的频域增益调制动态正则化功率谱密度演化，建立空间纹理与谱能量流之间的显式桥梁。

Conclusion: SC-Flow通过谱一致性校正机制在保持全局结构一致性的同时恢复了精细解剖结构保真度，且仅需单次函数评估即可完成翻译，兼顾了效率与质量。

Abstract: We present Spectral Consistent Flow (SC-Flow), a 3D medical image translation framework with a single function evaluation (1-NFE) in the latent space. This approach reformulates medical image translation as a stochastic Brownian bridge process that directly constructs a mapping between source and target modalities by predicting the support regularized mean velocity field. To mitigate modality entanglement, over-smoothing, and artifacts induced by the implicit low-pass modulation of the latent average velocity, we introduce a Spectral Consistency Corrector that dynamically regularizes the evolution of the power spectral density via learnable frequency-domain gain modulation. This mechanism establishes an explicit bridge between spatial textures and spectral energy flow, enabling the model to recover fine-grained anatomical fidelity while maintaining global structural coherence. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that SC-Flow delivers significantly more accurate, consistent, and robust performance across various translation scenarios.

</details>


### [79] [Spectral Heat Flow for Conservative Token Condensation in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10640)

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpecFlow提出了一种基于训练自由框架的视觉token压缩方法，通过谱热流、自适应空间划分和核心集汇合三大策略，在保留88.9%视觉token的情况下达到95.6%的原始性能，实现了高效且无损的视觉信息压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在推理时需要处理长序列视觉token，计算成本高昂。已有的token剪枝方法在高压缩率下往往失效，原因在于它们盲目丢弃信息、破坏空间结构或导致多样性坍塌。

Method: SpecFlow是一个无需训练的自由框架，包含三个核心组件：(i) 通过谱热流计算稳定重要性场，保持结构连贯性；(ii) 自适应空间划分分配预算，保证空间覆盖；(iii) 将丢弃信息聚合为核心集汇合点，维持统计守恒。将视觉token视为kNN图中的节点进行处理。

Result: 实验表明SpecFlow在多项任务、多种VLM架构和不同剪枝比例下均优于现有方法。特别地，LLaVA-1.5在使用SpecFlow后即使剪枝掉88.9%的视觉token，仍能保留95.6%的原始性能。

Conclusion: 提出了一种从破坏性剪枝到保守性聚合的范式转变，即通过严格保证空间覆盖和统计守恒来实现稳定高效的token压缩。该方法即插即用，无需微调，且与FlashAttention兼容。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are costly at inference time because they must process long sequences of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods often degrade under high compression by blindly discarding information, breaking spatial structure or collapsing diversity. We propose SpecFlow, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm from destructive pruning to conservative condensation, strictly enforcing spatial coverage and statistical conservation to ensure stability. Treating visual tokens as nodes in a $k$NN graph, SpecFlow (i) computes a stable importance field via spectral heat flow to preserve structural coherence, (ii) allocates budgets via adaptive spatial partitioning to guarantee coverage, and (iii) aggregates discarded information into coreset sinks to maintain statistical conservation. The method is plug-and-play, requires no fine-tuning, and is compatible with FlashAttention. Experiments confirm that our SpecFlow outperforms SOTA methods across tasks, VLM architectures, and pruning ratios. Notably, LLaVA-1.5 with SpecFlow retains 95.6\% of original performance despite pruning 88.9\% of visual tokens, offering an exceptional efficiency-accuracy balance. Code is available at https://github.com/Lzy-dot/SpecFlow

</details>

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于答案条件链式思维（answer-conditioned CoT）蒸馏方法，用于快速适应小规模视觉语言模型（VLM）到工业视觉检测任务。通过让前沿VLM基于正确答案生成视觉解释，再用LoRA微调3B参数模型，仅需18-30张标注图像即可在四项工业分类任务上超越直接微调，平均提升1.7-4.4个百分点。在焊缝X光片分类上，微调后的3B模型以24张训练图像超越GPT-4.1达10.0个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业环境中基于AI的视觉检测部署面临需求频繁变化、新缺陷类型不断出现以及大规模标注数据集稀缺等挑战，亟需一种能够利用极少标注数据快速适应新任务的方法。

Method: 采用答案条件链式思维蒸馏：首先让前沿VLM（如GPT-4.1）接收训练图像及其正确标签，生成合理的视觉解释；然后通过LoRA对3B参数的小规模VLM在这些推理增强的样本上进行微调。答案条件的设定确保所有训练推理都导向正确结论，避免前沿模型在困难任务上低准确率（最低24.1%）带来的错误推理污染。

Result: 在四项工业分类任务（涵盖三种图像模态）上，每任务仅用18-30张标注图像，每任务4个种子共32次训练，所提方法在所有16个种子-任务组合上均优于直接微调，平均提升1.7-4.4个百分点。消融实验表明，无答案条件时错误推理导致性能下降17.8个百分点。在焊缝X光片分类上，微调后的3B模型以24张训练图像超越GPT-4.1达10.0个百分点。

Conclusion: 答案条件链式思维蒸馏是一种高效的少样本工业视觉检测模型适配方法，能够以极少标注数据实现小模型对前沿大模型的性能超越，且性能提升来源于推理质量而非额外训练步数。

Abstract: Deploying AI-based visual inspection in manufacturing is hard because requirements change often, new defect types appear, and large labeled datasets are rarely available. We propose answer-conditioned chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation for rapidly adapting small vision-language models (VLMs) to new industrial tasks using minimal labeled data. A frontier VLM receives each training image along with its correct label and generates a justified visual explanation. A 3B-parameter model is then fine-tuned on these reasoning-augmented examples via LoRA. By conditioning on correct answers, we ensure all training reasoning is directed toward the correct conclusion, which is critical because frontier models score as low as 24.1% on our hardest task. We validate on four industrial classification tasks spanning three image modalities using only 18 to 30 labeled images per task. Across 4 seeds per task (32 training runs), our method outperforms direct fine-tuning on all 16 seed-task combinations, with mean improvements of +1.7 to +4.4 percentage points. A controlled equal-budget experiment confirms the improvement comes from reasoning quality, not additional training steps. An unconditioned baseline demonstrates that with out answer-conditioning, wrong reasoning degrades performance by 17.8 percentage points. On weld radiograph classification, the fine-tuned 3B model outperforms GPT-4.1 by 10.0pp using just 24 training images.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 构建HyperBank——一个可微分的经典图像处理算子库（包含Frangi血管增强、Sauvola阈值金字塔、结构张量响应、梯度幅值和LoG滤波器），在少样本支持集上拟合，在独立测试集上评估，并与大型基础模型对比。

Conclusion: 紧凑的可解释经典先验库在少样本显微镜分割任务中具有竞争力，可作为分析工具揭示哪些经典线索承载了少样本信号，但不应被视为基础模型的通用替代品。

Abstract: Few-shot spheroid segmentation must adapt to new cell lines, microscopes, and illumination conditions from only a small set of annotated images. While foundation few-shot segmenters can be accurate, their large opaque backbones make it difficult to understand which visual cues drive success or failure. We study this question with HyperBank, a differentiable bank of classical image-processing operators combining Frangi vesselness, a Sauvola threshold pyramid, structure-tensor responses, gradient magnitude, and Laplacian-of-Gaussian filters. HyperBank is fitted on the annotated support images and evaluated on disjoint held-out images across three independently acquired spheroid datasets. We treat it not as a general replacement for foundation models, but as a compact, interpretable few-shot microscopy pipeline and an analytic-prior probe of which classical cues carry the few-shot signal. The results show that, adapted on the same few annotated support images, a compact bank of analytic priors is competitive with, and on small-cluster, contrast-driven data can outperform, much larger foundation models, while those models remain stronger on externally sourced, texture-dominated spheroids. Leave-one-family-out ablations indicate that the useful few-shot signal is distributed across operator families and strengthened by support-set-tuned morphology.

</details>


### [82] [Incremental Online Scene Reconstruction by 3D Gaussian Triangulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10690)
*Yanjin Zhu,Shaofan Liu,Jianke Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在线增量式场景重建框架，通过直接三角化密集几何高斯表示来实时重建和更新高保真显式网格，无需离线转换，并引入平面拉紧约束和对历史区域的动态冻结策略，在渲染质量和重建精度上均优于传统高斯方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于3D高斯泼溅的场景增量重建方法大多需要将优化后的高斯离线转换为隐式场才能提取显式网格，无法与下游任务无缝集成，限制了实时应用。

Method: 提出在线框架，直接对密集几何高斯表示进行三角化以重建和更新显式网格；设计直接网格化算法从高斯集合中高效提取并更新网格；引入基于平面的拉紧约束，将3D高斯原语动态对齐到局部近似表面；对完全优化的历史区域动态冻结以减少长序列处理中的内存和计算开销。

Result: 在公共数据集上的实验表明，该方法在渲染质量和重建精度上均优于传统基于高斯的方法。

Conclusion: 提出的在线增量式显式网格重建框架能有效克服传统高斯方法需离线转换的局限，兼顾高质量渲染与增量表面重建，显著降低了长序列处理的计算开销。

Abstract: Incremental scene reconstruction is essential for real-world applications. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting shows strong potential, most existing approaches require offline conversion of the optimized Gaussians into an intermediate implicit field for explicit mesh extraction, which hinders seamless integration with downstream tasks. To address this limitation, we propose a novel online framework that incrementally reconstructs and updates high-fidelity explicit meshes by directly triangulating a dense geometric Gaussian representation, which supports both high-quality rendering and incremental surface reconstruction. Moreover, we present a direct meshing algorithm that efficiently extracts and updates the mesh from the Gaussian set. To ensure mesh accuracy, we enforce a plane-based pulling constraint that dynamically aligns 3D Gaussian primitives to the approximated local surface. Furthermore, our framework significantly reduces memory and computational overhead during long-sequence processing by dynamically freezing fully optimized historical regions. Experiments on public datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms conventional Gaussian-based methods on both rendering quality and reconstruction accuracy.

</details>


### [83] [Effective Synthetic Image Detection via Noise Residual Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10695)

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI合成图像检测方法依赖大量标注数据的有监督训练，成本高且在未知生成模型上性能退化，需要一种无需训练、泛化能力强的检测方法。

Method: 1) 使用预训练Noiseprint++提取噪声残差指纹；2) 冻结Vision Transformer (ViT) 从噪声残差中提取多尺度特征；3) 自适应加权融合多尺度特征；4) 仅需少量真实图像样本初始化聚类中心，通过无监督K-Means区分真实与合成图像。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上平均准确率82.2%，优于现有最先进检测器的泛化能力，在扩散模型合成图像上表现尤其出色，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性。

Conclusion: 无需训练的NoiseCluSID方法有效解决了监督检测方法的泛化瓶颈，尤其在扩散类型合成图像上表现出色，且各模块设计均被验证有效。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has made synthetic images remarkably realistic, posing security threats such as misinformation and fraud. It is significant to detect the synthetic image in the manner of passive and blind image authentication. Most existing detectors rely on supervised training with large labeled datasets, leading to high costs and degraded performance on unknown generative models. To attenuate such deficiencies, we propose a training-free detection method. Specifically, noise residual fingerprints are first extracted by a simple yet effective pre-trained Noiseprint++ model. Then multi-scale features are further extracted from such residual by a frozen Vision Transformer (ViT), followed by adaptive weighted fusion. Only a few real image samples are used needed to initialize the clustering centers for unsupervised K-Means, distinguishing real and synthetic images without training. Extensive evaluations on four benchmark datasets show that our proposed scheme achieves an average accuracy of 82.2%, outperforming the state-of-the-art detectors on generalization ability. Superior performance is gained on the popular diffusion type of synthetic images, and the effectiveness of each module is validated by ablation studies. Source code will be publicly available at https://github.com/multimediaFor/NoiseCluSID.

</details>


### [84] [Traj-VLN: Learning Pixel-Space Interaction via Autoregressive Trajectory Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10744)
*Changfei Fu,Guangcheng Chen,Wenjun Xu,Hong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出通过自回归轨迹生成在2D像素空间微调视觉-语言模型(VLM)实现连续环境下的视觉-语言导航(VLN-CE)，无需深度或3D几何信息，即在当前观测图像底部中心预测一系列像素坐标形成导航轨迹。实验表明像素空间轨迹监督显著提升VLN性能，且模型在有限计算资源和训练数据下达到SOTA水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLN任务可分解为一系列3D空间交互子任务，但VLMs主要在RGB图像对话上预训练，难以理解涉及深度感知的空间交互（如"走到沙发尽头左转"）。现有方法通常引入深度或3D几何信息，但这些信息在VLM预训练中很少出现。因此需要一种无需额外几何信息的替代方案。

Method: 提出在VLN-CE任务中，不引入深度或3D几何信息，而是直接在2D像素空间微调VLM。具体方法：给定语言指令和历史观测，模型通过自回归方式依次预测一系列像素坐标，在当前观测图像底部中心绘制一条轨迹。利用像素空间轨迹监督而非离散动作学习来训练模型。

Result: 实验验证像素空间轨迹监督显著优于像素目标(pixel-goal)监督和离散动作学习；旗舰模型在有限计算资源和训练数据下达到SOTA级别性能。

Conclusion: 证明了通过2D像素空间轨迹生成可以有效地将VLM应用于VLN-CE任务，避免了引入VLM预训练中不常见的深度/3D信息，同时实现了优异的导航性能。

Abstract: Benefiting from the powerful priors embedded in large-scale pre-training data and the emerging commonsense reasoning ability, large language models (LLMs) have shown unprecedented generalization capabilities in many research fields. Recently, projecting visual embeddings into the language space via vision-language models (VLMs) to achieve sim-toreal and cross-scene generalization has become a prevailing paradigm in the field of Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE). VLN requires an embodied agent to navigate through unseen environments following natural linguistic instructions. We emphasize that a VLN task can be decomposed into a sequence of sub-tasks, each corresponding to a process of 3D spatial interaction with the environments described by instructions such as "walk to the end of the sofa and turn left." However, such spatial interactions involving moving into the image along the direction of depth sensing are puzzling for VLMs as they were predominantly trained on conversations with RGB images. Rather than incorporating depth or 3D geometric information-which VLMs rarely encounter during pretrainingwe propose an alternative approach: fine-tuning VLMs to learn navigation interactions directly in 2D pixel space through autoregressive trajectory generation. Given a linguistic instruction and historical observations, our model sequentially predicts a series of pixel coordinates, drawing a trajectory from the bottom center of the current observation. While prior work has proved that pixel-goal supervision outperforms learning of discrete actions, our experiments further verify that the supervision of pixel-space trajectory significantly enhances VLN performance. Moreover, we demonstrate that our flagship model achieves state-of-the-art level performance with relatively limited computational resources and training data.

</details>


### [85] [Water Reflection Detection Using Symmetric Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10749)
*Shuxuan Yao,Chengjia Wang,Jianyuan Sun,Junyu Dong,Xinghui Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SAWRD-Net，利用水的非完美反射对称性，结合二面体群等变卷积和矩阵分解解码器，实现自然水场景中反射轴的高精度检测，真阳性率达0.890，优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水面反射会导致标准深度学习模型在目标检测和语义分割中产生大量假阳性和假阴性，而现有方法对自然水场景反射轴的检测效果不佳，亟需一种鲁棒的反射轴检测方法以提升场景理解能力。

Method: SAWRD-Net采用端到端框架：1）二面体群等变卷积层提取编码旋转和镜像对称性的几何一致特征图；2）多尺度反射等变模块通过对称注意力机制聚合跨尺度特征并突出反射相关区域；3）矩阵分解解码器将高维特征分解为低秩参数空间和置信空间，直接回归反射轴关键点；4）鲁棒主成分分析（RPCA）拟合最终反射轴。

Result: 在最大可用水反射场景数据集上，SAWRD-Net的真阳性率达到0.890（基于人工标注），全面超越现有水面反射检测方法。

Conclusion: 利用水的非完美反射对称性设计对称感知网络可有效解决水面反射轴检测难题，为后续场景理解任务提供可靠基础。

Abstract: Reflections of water pose a significant challenge for computer vision systems, as standard deep learning models frequently confuse objects with their mirror images, producing spurious false positives and negatives in tasks such as object detection and semantic segmentation. As a result, detecting reflection axes in natural-water scenes is pivotal for reliable object detection and scene understanding. To mitigate this issue, we leverage the intrinsic imperfect reflective symmetry of water and introduce a Symmetry-Aware Water Reflection Detection Network, namely, SAWRD-Net, that couples dihedral group-equivariant convolutions with a matrix-decomposition decoder in an end-to-end framework. First, dihedral group convolutional layers extract geometry-consistent feature maps that explicitly encode both rotational and mirror symmetries. A Multi-scale Reflection Equivariant block then aggregates features across scales and employs a symmetric-attention mechanism to highlight reflection-relevant regions. The proposed matrix-decomposition decoder factorizes high-dimensional features into compact low-rank parameter and confidence spaces, after which the network directly regresses keypoints on the reflection axis. Then a robust principal component analysis fits the final axis. Evaluated on the largest available water reflection scene data set, SAWRD-Net achieves a true-positive rate of 0.890 against human annotations, outperforming all existing water reflection detectors.

</details>


### [86] [TriCons-Pose: Triangle-Invariant Geometric Consistency Learning for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10754)
*Zuzhi Yang,Shuai Wang,Mounir Kaaniche,Ziwei Li,Zhiming Cheng,Zhidong Zhao,Chenggang Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TriCons-Pose方法，通过三角不变几何一致性学习解决类别级物体姿态估计中对应关系几何不稳定的问题，在REAL275、CAMERA25和HouseCat6D数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于关键点对应的类别级物体姿态估计方法过度依赖强特征学习，忽视了所建立对应关系在不同扰动下的几何稳定性，导致在类内形状变化和遮挡场景下姿态恢复脆弱。

Method: 提出TriCons-Pose框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 结构一致关键点检测器(SCKD)，通过归一化成对距离匹配强制跨视图结构一致性来识别鲁棒关键点；(2) 姿态不变几何聚合器(PIGA)，通过注入基于三角的位姿不变描述符到局部到全局注意力机制中来增强关键点表示。同时引入额外的几何一致性损失进行优化。

Result: 在REAL275、CAMERA25和HouseCat6D三个数据集上的大量实验证明了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: TriCons-Pose通过几何一致性学习锚定稳定关键点并聚合姿态不变线索，实现了可靠的规范映射和准确的姿态估计，有效解决了类内形状变化和遮挡下的鲁棒性问题。

Abstract: Category-level object pose estimation is a crucial yet challenging task in both academia and industry, and has achieved remarkable success by leveraging keypoint-based correspondence paradigms. However, most existing methods increasingly rely on stronger feature learning while overlooking whether the established correspondences are geometrically stable across diverse perturbations. This often results in fragile pose recovery under intra-class shape variations and occlusions. To tackle this challenge, we develop a novel Triangle-Invariant Geometric Consistency Learning for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation (TriCons-Pose) to anchor stable keypoints and aggregate pose-invariant cues, yielding reliable canonical mapping and accurate pose estimation. Specifically, a Structure-Consistent Keypoint Detector (SCKD) is designed to identify robust keypoints by enforcing cross-view structural consistency via normalized pairwise distance matching. Moreover, we propose a Pose-Invariant Geometric Aggregator (PIGA) to augment keypoint representations by injecting triangle-based pose-invariant descriptors into a local-to-global attention mechanism. The proposed framework is optimized using standard objective functions while incorporating an additional geometry consistency loss. Extensive experiments on REAL275, CAMERA25, and HouseCat6D datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [87] [TOLiD: Bridging the Architecture Gap in Vision Foundation Model to LiDAR Pretraining via Token Lifting for Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10762)
*Sutharsan Mahendran,Darshana Priyasad,Kaushik Roy,Tharindu Fernando,Sridha Sridharan,Clinton Fookes,Peyman Moghadam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TOLiD提出了一种从视觉基础模型(VFM)到LiDAR主干的自监督蒸馏预训练方法，通过引入学生Vision Transformer并使用Frustum Pooling和Frustum Attention实现跨模态、跨架构的token级蒸馏，在多个LiDAR数据集上展示了优异的迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨模态蒸馏方法将VFM视为冻结特征源，强制LiDAR主干去匹配固定图像嵌入，需要同时跨越模态鸿沟（图像vs点云）和架构鸿沟（密集ViT token vs稀疏3D编码器），导致学生模型学习困难。

Method: 1) 将LiDAR主干与学生Vision Transformer耦合，学生ViT从冻结的VFM教师初始化；2) 使用Frustum Pooling将每个图像patch视锥内的点特征聚合为token，再通过Frustum Attention处理；3) 结合可见性掩码进行token级蒸馏；4) LiDAR-only部署时，使用掩码双线性采样将token特征回传到逐点表示。

Result: 在五个异构LiDAR数据集和四个跨传感器适应对上进行了广泛评估，展示了冻结主干+轻量头下的改进迁移性能。

Conclusion: TOLiD通过设计兼容的patch-token表示和蒸馏机制，有效弥合了跨模态和跨架构差距，为LiDAR自监督预训练提供了更高效的范式。

Abstract: Cross-modal distillation from Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to LiDAR backbones has recently emerged as a self-supervised pretraining strategy that reduces reliance on dense point-wise annotation for 3D scene understanding. However, existing distillation pipelines typically treat the VFM as a frozen feature source and train a heterogeneous 3D backbone to match fixed image embeddings, forcing the student to bridge both the modality gap and the cross-architecture gap between dense ViT token representations and sparse 3D encoders. We propose TOLiD, a self-supervised pretraining method for LiDAR representation learning that addresses this gap by coupling a LiDAR backbone with a student Vision Transformer (ViT) initialized from a frozen VFM teacher and applying supervision over compatible patch-token representations. TOLiD converts the set of point features within each image patch frustum into a token using Frustum Pooling followed by Frustum Attention, and performs token-level distillation with visibility masking. For LiDAR-only deployment, we lift token features back to per-point representations using masked bilinear sampling to avoid patches that have limited LiDAR points. We extensively evaluate TOLiD on five heterogeneous LiDAR datasets and four cross-sensor adaptation pairs, demonstrating improved transfer with frozen backbones and lightweight heads.

</details>


### [88] [RED-Sphere: Hyperspherical Residual Edge Debiasing for Cross-Population Fundus Disease Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10777)
*Yan Lin,Ziheng Wang,Shuang Chen,Amir Atapour-Abarghouei,Stephen McGough*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RED-Sphere是一个即插即用的鲁棒性框架，通过边缘和特征能量先验估计捷径敏感响应、残差软门控衰减主导响应、反事实一致性约束以及归一化球面原型预测，在严格源域独训跨人群设定下显著提升医学图像分类器对未见人群的泛化性能（AMD和DR任务上平均F1提升1.28和2.98点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学图像分类器在单一源人群训练后，面对外观、采集方式和疾病流行率不同的外部人群时性能显著下降。现有公平性和鲁棒性方法要么需要群体监督，要么将外观变化视为无差别干扰，当人群相关的低级线索与病变证据共享边缘和纹理结构时这些方法效果不足。

Method: 提出RED-Sphere框架：(1) 利用边缘和特征能量先验估计捷径敏感响应；(2) 通过残差软门控衰减主导响应；(3) 采用反事实一致性损失和分离损失正则化掩码后的干扰视图；(4) 使用归一化球面原型预测标签，偏好角度语义证据而非源相关激活幅度，同时保留病灶结构。

Result: 在严格的White-only Harvard-FairVision协议下，RED-Sphere在所有20个任务和骨干网络对比中均提升留出集macro-F1，AMD和DR任务平均提升1.28和2.98个F1点；AUC和PR-AUC、可视化诊断、消融实验和敏感性分析进一步支持更强的外部语义对齐和更稳定的角度疾病几何。

Conclusion: RED-Sphere作为一种即插即用的鲁棒性框架，有效解决了源域独训跨人群设定下医学图像分类器因外观捷径导致的泛化问题，且不局限于视网膜解剖结构，可适配不同模态的干扰先验。

Abstract: Medical image classifiers are often trained within one source population, yet clinical deployment requires robustness to patients whose appearance, acquisition style, and disease prevalence differ from the source cohort. Existing fairness and robustness methods often require group supervision or treat appearance variation as an undifferentiated nuisance, which is insufficient when population-correlated low-level cues and lesion evidence share edge and texture structure. We study a strict source-only cross-population setting, where external populations are unseen during optimization, validation, scheduling, hyperparameter and model selection. We propose RED-Sphere, a plug-and-play robustness framework for image classification under unseen population shifts. It estimates shortcut-sensitive nuisance responses with an edge and feature energy prior, attenuates dominant responses through residual soft gating, regularizes masked nuisance views with counterfactual-inspired consistency and separation losses, and predicts labels with normalized spherical prototypes. It favours angular semantic evidence over source-correlated activation magnitude while preserving lesion structure. Although demonstrated on 2D Scanning Laser Ophthalmoscopy (SLO) fundus classification for Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD) and Diabetic Retinopathy (DR), RED-Sphere is not tied to retinal anatomy: the same principle can be adapted with modality-specific nuisance priors wherever appearance shortcuts and semantic evidence are entangled. Under a strict White-only Harvard-FairVision protocol, RED-Sphere improves held-out macro-F1 across all 20 task and backbone comparisons, with average gains of 1.28 and 2.98 F1 points on AMD and DR. Gains in AUC and PR-AUC, visual diagnostics, ablations, and sensitivity analyses further support stronger external semantic alignment and more stable angular disease geometry.

</details>


### [89] [Is Energy Guidance All You Need? Training-Free Norm Injection for Driving World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10781)
*Xiyan Su,Frank Diermeyer,Markus Lienkamp*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探究了基于视频扩散主干构建的驾驶世界模型是否无需重新训练即可实现可控性。实验表明，通过可微能量函数在采样时引导修正流驾驶世界模型的规划轨迹，可使其遵守交通规范（如刹车），但生成的视频尚未完全跟随被引导的轨迹，指出跨流耦合是实现端到端可控滚动的关键需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大视频扩散主干的驾驶世界模型虽能生成逼真场景，但难以控制：强制遵守交通规范通常需要重新训练主干网络或依赖手工构建的布局。作者质疑可控性是否必然需要训练，探索无需知识特定重新训练即可实现控制的可能性。

Method: 提出基于修正流（rectified-flow）的驾驶世界模型，联合生成未来视频和规划的自车轨迹。在采样阶段，通过可微能量函数（编码驾驶规范）对规划轨迹进行引导，无需重新训练扩散主干。具体使用Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT作为主干，演示能量引导使模型在反事实目标处刹车。

Result: 能量引导成功改变了规划轨迹（如刹车），但生成的视频并未跟随被引导的轨迹通过主干的联合自注意力机制。这表明当前方法在视频生成与轨迹引导之间仍存在不一致，未实现真正的端到端可控滚动。

Conclusion: 跨流耦合（cross-stream coupling）是实现端到端可控驾驶世界模型滚动的关键需求，当前主干中视频轨迹与规划轨迹之间的耦合不足，导致引导效果无法传导至视频生成，未来需要在模型架构层面加强不同流之间的交互。

Abstract: Driving world models built on large video-diffusion backbones generate realistic scenes but are hard to control: enforcing a traffic norm typically means retraining the backbone or conditioning it on hand-built layouts. We ask whether controllability requires training at all. Our experiment shows that a rectified-flow driving world model, which jointly generates future video and a planned ego trajectory, can have its planned trajectory steered entirely at sampling time by differentiable energy functions that encode driving norms, without knowledge-specific retraining of the diffusion backbone. Concretely, we demonstrate that a world model built on Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT backbone can be steered to brake at a counterfactual target by injecting energy guidance at sampling time. However, we find that the generated video does not yet follow the steered trajectory through the backbone's joint self-attention and identify the cross-stream coupling as a crucial requirement for end-to-end-controllable rollouts.

</details>


### [90] [Toward Efficient Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation Using Only Low-Magnification Histopathological Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10783)
*Dung Minh Do,Nhat-Thanh Huynh,Duc Minh Huynh,Doanh C. Bui,Khang Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了在低分辨率存储设置下，弱监督组织病理图像分割的性能。通过模拟不同放大倍数的输入图像，使用插值和深度学习重建方法恢复原始尺寸，评估弱监督分割方法对分辨率退化的响应。研究发现重建质量指标不足以预测下游分割性能，并确定了小尺度结构定位显著下降的关键退化点，为高效数字病理存储系统设计提供指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全切片图像存储和传输资源密集，且像素级标注费时费力。因此需要探究在有限标注（图像级标签而非像素级标签）的低倍病理图像是否能达到与高倍图像相当的性能。

Method: 从高分辨率图像块开始，模拟低倍率输入，使用插值和基于深度学习的重建方法将其恢复到原始尺寸，然后应用弱监督分割流程。通过这一框架定量评估弱监督方法对不同分辨率退化水平的响应。

Result: 重建质量指标单独不足以预测下游分割性能；存在一个关键退化点，在该点小尺度结构的定位显著下降。

Conclusion: 研究结果为设计高效的数字病理存储系统同时保持可靠的自动分析提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Whole-slide images (WSIs) provide rich tissue-level and cellular-level information, but storing and transmitting high-magnification pathology data is resource-intensive. Moreover, annotating WSIs at the pixel level is labor-intensive and time-consuming. Therefore, it is important to investigate whether low-magnification pathology images with limited annotations (i.e., image-level instead of pixel-level labels) can achieve performance comparable to high-magnification images. This paper presents a systematic benchmark study on weakly supervised histopathological image segmentation under different low-resolution storage settings. Starting from high-resolution image patches, we simulate lower-magnification inputs and reconstruct them to the original size using interpolation and deep learning-based reconstruction methods before applying the weakly-supervised segmentation pipeline. This framework enables a quantitative evaluation of how weakly supervised methods respond to different levels of resolution degradation. Experimental results show that reconstruction quality metrics alone are insufficient to predict downstream segmentation performance. In particular, the study identifies a critical degradation point where the localization of small-scale structures declines significantly. These findings provide practical guidance for designing efficient digital pathology storage systems while maintaining reliable automated analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/Dung-Dx/LowMagWSS

</details>


### [91] [Detecting AI-Generated Video: A Vision-Language Dual-View Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10787)
*Dylan Xinming Hou,Juntian Zhang,Xu Gu,Yichen Wu,Nils Lukas,Gus Xia,Xiuying Chen,Yuhan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了AI生成视频检测领域，提出将传统基于伪影的检测范式转向基于事实保真度验证的语义验证，构建了视觉-语言双视图四层分类体系，涵盖221篇文献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI生成视频的真实性快速提升，传统基于低级伪影的检测方法已不足够，亟需从低级检测转向高级语义验证的范式转变。

Method: 提出视觉-语言双视图分类体系（Vision-Language Dual-View taxonomy），将检测方法组织为四层层次结构：内在线索分析、时空一致性建模、跨模态一致性推理、语言引导的世界级推理。

Result: 基于221篇文献的系统综述，综合了AIGC-V生成范式、检测方法全景、评估指标与基准，并识别出当前挑战与未来方向。

Conclusion: AI生成视频检测正从传统伪影匹配向基于证据的语义验证转变，视觉-语言模型和智能推理管线是未来实现鲁棒、可解释、可信检测的关键方向。

Abstract: The evolving realism of AI-generated Videos (AIGC-V) is rapidly rendering traditional artifact-centric detection insufficient, necessitating a paradigm shift from low-level inspection to high-level semantic verification. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of AIGC-V detection, reframing the task as Factual Fidelity Verification, which asks whether the events, entities, and physical processes depicted in a video are consistent with real-world facts. To systematize this rapidly evolving field, we propose a Vision-Language Dual-View taxonomy that organizes existing methods into a hierarchical, four-layer landscape, spanning intrinsic cue analysis, spatiotemporal consistency modeling, cross-modal consistency reasoning, and language-guided world-level reasoning. This dual-view framing highlights a fundamental transition from artifact matching in traditional deepfake detection to evidence-based semantic verification enabled by vision-language models and agentic reasoning pipelines. Based on a systematic review of 221 works, we synthesize AIGC-V generation paradigms, survey the landscape of detection methods, and review evaluation metrics and benchmarks in line with proposed views. Finally, we discuss current challenges and identify promising directions toward robust, explainable, and trustworthy detection.

</details>


### [92] [MAC-Splat: Multi-Attribute Consistency for High-Fidelity Sparse-View Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10792)
*Jinqian Yang,Yichen Wu,Wanhua Li,Haokun Lin,Renzhen Wang,Xiangchu Feng,Xixi Jia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAC-Splat 提出了一种基于多属性一致性（MAC）损失的直接3D监督训练框架，利用MASt3R几何骨干网络和DINOv3编码器获取语义感知的2D对应点作为几何锚点，联合正则化匹配高斯体的位置、形状和外观等3D属性，在稀疏视图条件下显著提升了3D场景重建质量，在ScanNet++上相比Splatt3R提升了超过4.5 dB PSNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可泛化3D高斯泼溅方法在稀疏视图下由于仅依赖2D光度损失监督，无法解决深度和对应关系的不确定性，导致几何伪影严重。

Method: 基于MASt3R几何骨干网络和冻结的DINOv3编码器获取语义感知的2D对应点作为几何锚点，提出多属性一致性（MAC）损失，在共同世界坐标系中对匹配高斯体的位置、形状和外观进行联合正则化，并对离群点和协方差矩阵几何结构具有鲁棒性。

Result: 在ScanNet++上，相比Splatt3R平均PSNR提升超过4.5 dB，LPIPS降低，且在不同重叠率和相机位姿间距下均保持优势。

Conclusion: 直接的多属性3D一致性目标结合高质量对应点，能有效解决病态的稀疏视图重建问题。

Abstract: Reconstructing high-fidelity 3D scenes from sparse-views remains a central problem in generalizable neural rendering. Existing generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods often exhibit geometric artifacts in sparse-view settings, since supervision based solely on 2D photometric losses cannot resolve depth and correspondence ambiguities. To address this issue, we propose MAC-Splat, a training framework built around direct 3D consistency supervision. MAC-Splat builds on the MASt3R geometric backbone and a frozen DINOv3 encoder to obtain semantically informed 2D correspondences, which serve as geometric anchors for 3D supervision. Using these anchors, we define the Multi-Attribute Consistency (MAC) loss. This objective jointly regularizes the 3D attributes of matched Gaussians, including their position, shape, and appearance, by enforcing agreement in a common world coordinate frame. The formulation is robust to outliers and respects the geometry of covariance matrices, which leads to stable training under sparse-view conditions. Experiments on ScanNet++ show that MAC-Splat outperforms strong baselines, with particularly large gains under different overlap regimes. In particular, it improves average PSNR over Splatt3R by more than 4.5 dB, reduces LPIPS, and maintains performance as the camera pose gap increases. These results indicate that a direct, multi-attribute 3D consistency objective, when combined with high-quality correspondences, is effective for addressing the ill-posed sparse-view reconstruction problem.

</details>


### [93] [Mixture of Cognitive Experts in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10796)
*Robert Wijaya,Ngai-Man Cheung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于布鲁姆分类学的证据驱动多模态推理框架，通过两阶段认知言语化（字面证据摘要+布鲁姆言语化）和轻量级推理轨迹模块，将多专家视觉编码器输出转化为可解释的分层推理轨迹，显著提升LVLM的感知与推理能力，并支持细粒度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM在处理不同认知层次的视觉语言问题时，采用相同的感知-推理路由，缺乏适应性；同时多编码器专家输出的异构信息难以整合为可验证、可解释且减少幻觉的统一表示。

Method: 1) 利用布鲁姆分类学作为分层推理协议；2) 两阶段认知言语化：先产生字面证据摘要（将专家输出分解为原子证据陈述），再执行布鲁姆言语化（将证据转化为分阶段推理轨迹）；3) 轻量级推理轨迹模块定量分析轨迹，显式化证据使用和推理进展。

Result: 在感知和推理能力上观察到多项改进；推理轨迹模块的定量分析表明，不同查询会引发不同的认知入口水平和证据使用轨迹，支持细粒度分析。

Conclusion: 该框架通过结构化认知协议和显式推理轨迹，有效提升了LVLM的可解释性、可验证性和推理质量，为不同复杂度查询提供自适应路由。

Abstract: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) require strong reasoning over both visual and textual input. Recent work suggests that cognitive elements, especially diverse representations and metacognition, correlate with better performance. Many of the needed perceptual functions are already provided by specialized domain-specific computer vision models, which act as the perceptual subsystem for detecting objects, localizing them, inferring states, recovering spatial layout, and reading text. The key challenge is to integrate these multi-encoder experts into a trustworthy, interpretable, and coherent representation that improves verifiability and reduces hallucinations. This is difficult because vision-language questions span different cognitive levels, yet most LVLM pipelines apply the same perception-reasoning routing regardless of the demand of each query. We propose an evidence-driven multimodal reasoning framework that utilizes a Bloom-inspired taxonomy as a hierarchical reasoning protocol. The two-stage cognitive verbalization first produces a Literal Evidence Summary by decomposing expert outputs into short, atomic evidence statements. It then performs Bloom Verbalization to turn these evidence items into a staged reasoning trace, and a lightweight Reasoning Trace Module quantitatively analyzes the trace to make evidence usage and reasoning progression explicit. Through this integration, we observed several improvements in perception and reasoning abilities. Moreover, the trace module provides quantitative evidence that different queries induce different cognitive entry levels and evidence-use trajectories that enable fine-grained analysis.

</details>


### [94] [Compositional Context Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Model for Complex Assembly Action Understanding from Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10797)
*Hao Zheng,Jinyi Huang,Tiantian Zheng,Xun Xu,Tuka Alhanai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Compositional Context Fine-Tuning (CCFT) 方法，将装配动作分解为语义元素（动词、对象、工具），并利用 Layer-Partitioned Alternating Training (LP-AT) 实现多任务学习，在装配视频数据集上优于强基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机协作装配中，动作理解因细微运动与精细手物交互而极具挑战性，现有方法难以有效处理。

Method: 提出 CCFT，将装配动作分解为 Verb、Object、Tool 语义元素，通过模板化问答对微调 VLM；同时提出 LP-AT，将模型层分区并分配不同低秩适配器识别特定元素，交替更新权重以减少跨任务干扰。

Result: 在 HA-ViD-VQA 和 IKEA-ASM-VQA 数据集上，该方法一致优于强动作识别基线，并提供可解释的元素级预测。

Conclusion: CCFT 与 LP-AT 能有效提升装配动作理解性能，支持下游多样化应用。

Abstract: Assembly action understanding is a key enabler for effective human-robot collaborative assembly, yet it remains challenging due to subtle motions and fine-grained hand-object interactions. We adapt vision-language models (VLMs) to this challenging domain with Compositional Context Fine-Tuning (CCFT), a method that decomposes assembly actions into semantic elements (Verb, Object, Tool) and fine-tunes VLMs to recognize each action element using templated question-answering pairs. This approach ensures near-deterministic outputs. To enable efficient and effective multi-task learning under limited data, a Layer-Partitioned Alternating Training (LP-AT) method is presented, which assigns distinct model layers to recognize specific action elements through element-specific low-rank adapters. LP-AT alternates weight updates across element-specific adapters, reducing cross-task interference while enabling per-adapter hyperparameter optimization. Furthermore, we create HA-ViD-VQA and IKEA-ASM-VQA datasets from existing assembly video datasets. Extensive experiments on these datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong action recognition baselines while providing interpretable element-level predictions that can support diverse downstream applications.

</details>


### [95] [h-Flow: Flexible Flow-based Image Editing via Doob's h-Transform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10800)
*Zehui Guo,Zhen Wang,Junwei Shu,Yang Li,Changbo Wang,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出h-Flow，一种基于Doob h-Transform的无训练、有理论基础的流式图像编辑框架，通过将图像编辑重构为多终端事件下的条件生成，并引入速度正交分解来解耦重建与编辑方向，实现可控的源一致性与目标对齐平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于预训练文本到图像流模型的编辑方法通常需要在目标提示对齐和源图像一致性之间进行仔细平衡，且现有方法要么依赖反演流水线，要么依赖启发式的源到目标轨迹构建，这些方法往往依赖于特定架构设计或对超参数敏感。

Method: 1. 将Doob h-Transform从SDE模型扩展到确定性RF框架，通过构造具有相同边际分布的等价SDE；2. 设计专门的h-函数分别用于源一致性和目标对齐，得到闭式重建引导和基于速度的语义编辑信号；3. 引入速度正交分解来解耦重建和编辑方向，实现两个目标的可控权衡。

Result: 大量实验表明h-Flow在多种场景下实现了有效、鲁棒且灵活的图像编辑。

Conclusion: h-Flow提供了一种无训练、有理论基础的流式图像编辑方法，通过Doob h-Transform和速度正交分解有效解决了源一致性与目标对齐的平衡问题。

Abstract: Editing images with pre-trained text-to-image flow models typically requires carefully balancing target alignment with the desired prompt and source consistency with the original image. Existing approaches either rely on inversion-based pipelines or heuristic source-to-target trajectory constructions, which often depend on architecture-specific designs or are sensitive to hyperparameters. In this paper, we propose h-Flow, a training-free and theoretically grounded flow-based editing framework. Inspired by Doob's $h$-Transform, we reformulate image editing as conditional generation under multiple terminal events corresponding to source consistency and target alignment. We first extend the classical $h$-Transform from SDE-based models to the deterministic RF framework by constructing an equivalent SDE with identical marginals. Within this formulation, we design dedicated $h$-functions for source consistency and target alignment, yielding closed-form reconstruction guidance and velocity-based semantic editing signals. We further introduce a velocity orthogonal decomposition to decouple reconstruction and editing directions, enabling a controllable trade-off between the two objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that h-Flow achieves effective, robust, and flexible editing across diverse scenarios. The code will be released soon.

</details>


### [96] [3D-DefectBench: A Controlled Factorial Study of Vision-Language Model Evaluation Pipelines for Fine-Grained 3D Generation Defects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10826)
*Zhenyu Zhao,Nanshan Jia,Jihyeon Je,Yifu Tang,Alvin Chan,Michael Spedden,Michael V. Palleschi,Sui Huang,Jingshen Wang,Zeyu Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出3D-DefectBench基准，系统评估基于VLM的3D缺陷检测流程。通过控制4个流程因子（VLM、相机协议、视觉输入、提示模板），在84种推理设计上分析了约320万次缺陷决策。发现模型选择是最大影响因素，但其他因素也显著影响性能。标准化的六视图RGB协议能在成本与性能间取得良好平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化评估对于扩展生成式3D系统至关重要，但评估流程的可靠性取决于整个流水线（渲染方式、视觉证据、任务规范、人工标签构建等），而不仅仅是底层VLM模型。现有工作缺乏对完整评估流程的系统性分析。

Method: 提出3D-DefectBench基准，涵盖9种细粒度二分类缺陷（几何、纹理、提示遵循）。采用平衡因子设计，控制VLM、相机协议、视觉输入（RGB/深度/法线）、提示模板4个因子，共84种推理设计，约320万次缺陷评分决策，并在更广泛的前沿模型上进行分阶段验证。

Result: 模型选择是影响与人工标签一致性的最大因素，但其余因子也影响性能并与模型选择存在交互。六视图RGB协议与更密集的多视图或增强输入（深度/法线）表现相当。最佳VLM评判仍落后于经过训练的人工标注员；使用噪声较大的银标签时纹理一致性显著下降。

Conclusion: 自动化评判应作为完整流程进行评估，并根据人工参考体系进行校准，而非仅作为独立模型进行基准测试。

Abstract: Automated evaluation is essential for scaling generative 3D systems, where exhaustive human review is costly and slow. However, the reliability of an automated judge depends on the entire evaluation pipeline, not only the underlying vision-language model (VLM), but also how assets are rendered, what visual evidence is provided, how the task is specified, and how human reference labels are constructed. We introduce 3D-DefectBench, a benchmark and framework for systematic analysis of VLM-based 3D defect detection pipelines. It complements holistic ratings and pairwise preferences with nine fine-grained binary defects spanning geometry, texture, and prompt adherence, providing actionable diagnostics for generator development and judge evaluation. Using a balanced factorial design, we vary four pipeline factors, VLM, camera protocol, visual input, and prompt schema, across 84 inference designs and approximately 3.2 million scored defect decisions, followed by staged validation on a broader set of frontier models. Model choice is the largest determinant of agreement with human labels, but the remaining factors also affect performance, interact with model selection, and can change the best configuration. Within the evaluated design space, a compact six-view RGB protocol performs comparably to denser multi-view settings and inputs augmented with depth or surface normals, making it a strong cost-effective default. Under this standardized pipeline, the best of 12 VLM judges still lag behind trained human labelers, while texture agreement drops sharply when expert-consensus labels are replaced by noisier silver labels. These findings show that automated judges should be evaluated as complete pipelines and calibrated across human reference regimes, rather than benchmarked only as standalone models. We release labels, prompts, predictions, and Croissant metadata on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [97] [OmniX: Any-view and Any-time 4D Reconstruction via Feed-forward Trajectory Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10840)
*Yanqin Jiang,Tengfei Wang,Zhengwei Wang,Chenjie Cao,Junta Wu,Wenhan Luo,Weiming Hu,Jin Gao,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniX是一个前馈式4D重建框架，通过解耦动态运动与静态几何、利用紧凑动态令牌表示运动，从大相机运动视频中预测密集3D点轨迹，并在大规模合成数据集上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈4D重建方法要么预测逐帧静态点云而忽略前景运动，要么在估计点云轨迹时局限于小相机运动，无法在视角大幅变化下聚合多帧观测以重建完整动态场景。

Method: OmniX将动态运动建模与静态几何预测解耦，利用3D运动的稀疏低秩结构，通过紧凑的动态令牌集为所有像素生成轨迹场，高效保持全局交互；同时构建基于UE5的自动4D数据引擎，生成80K场景、128万多视角视频的大规模标注数据集。

Result: 在密集3D点轨迹预测和3D点跟踪任务上达到SOTA，在视频深度估计和相机位姿估计上也展现出竞争力。

Conclusion: OmniX通过解耦运动与几何、紧凑令牌表示以及大规模合成数据训练，有效突破了前馈4D重建在大相机运动下的局限性。

Abstract: Previous feed-forward 4D reconstruction methods either predict per-frame static point clouds, ignoring foreground motion, or estimate point cloud trajectories while being limited to small camera motions. This restricts their ability to aggregate observations over time and reconstruct complete dynamic scenes under large viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, we propose OmniX, a feed-forward 4D reconstruction framework that predicts dense 3D point trajectories for every pixel from videos with large camera motion. OmniX decouples dynamic motion modeling from static geometry prediction and represents motion using a compact set of dynamic tokens. By leveraging the sparse and low-rank structure of 3D motion, these tokens generate trajectory fields for all pixels across all images while efficiently preserving global interactions. To facilitate training, we further build an automatic UE5-based 4D data engine and introduce a large-scale dataset containing 80K scenes and 1.28M multi-view videos with full geometric annotations. OmniX achieves state-of-the-art performance on dense 3D point trajectory prediction and 3D point tracking, while also demonstrating competitive results on video depth estimation and camera pose estimation.

</details>


### [98] [Align and Segment: Unsupervised Learning for Building Segmentation From Misaligned Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10841)
*Venkanna Babu Guthula,Oswin Krause,Dimitri Gominski,Hui Zhang,Johan Mottelson,Ankit Kariryaa,Nico Lang,Christian Igel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种同时学习标签对齐与语义分割的Align and Segment (AnS)方法，通过空间变换模块纠正遥感图像中标签与图像间的未对齐问题，无需任何真值标签即可同时实现高质量建筑分割和精确对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感图像中来自不同来源（如OpenStreetMap）的标签与图像之间存在空间未对齐问题，这严重损害了监督学习模型的性能，现有方法缺乏在无需真值标签条件下同时处理对齐和分割的解决方案。

Method: 基于空间变换器模块（Spatial Transformer Module）对未对齐标签进行仿射变换，生成更好的学习目标；引入自监督正则化损失防止分割网络利用未对齐标签进行捷径学习；该方法与数据增强互补，无需任何真值标签。

Result: 在合成数据和多个城市真实数据上的实验表明，该方法能够同时实现高质量建筑分割和精确的标签-图像对齐。

Conclusion: AnS方法有效解决了遥感图像中标签未对齐问题，无需真值标签即可同时完成对齐与分割任务，具有实用价值。

Abstract: Supervised learning for image segmentation typically requires spatially aligned image and label sets. When images and labels originate from different sources, the pairing may be misaligned, which can significantly deteriorate the performance of the learned models. This is especially common in remote sensing, when aerial or satellite images are co-registered with labels from another source (e.g., OpenStreetMap). In this work, we propose a novel approach for training on misaligned labels, where we simultaneously learn the label alignment. Our align and segment (AnS) approach builds on the spatial transformer module to transform the misaligned labels using an affine transformation to provide a better learning target for a canonical semantic segmentation network. We prevent shortcut learning of misaligned labels in these semantic segmentation networks through a self-supervised regularization loss and show that it is complementary to data augmentation, especially for systematically misaligned training data. A decisive characteristic of our AnS approach is that it learns without requiring any golden labels. We experimentally show on both synthetic and real-world data from different cities that our approach enables high-quality building segmentation and precise label-image alignment at the same time. Code and derived datasets are available at https://github.com/venkanna37/align-and-segment

</details>


### [99] [Learning To Focus: Anatomy-Guided Attention Regularization for Medical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10851)
*Tonmoy Hossain,Atiqur Rahman,Farhana Hossain Swarnali,Miaomiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Locus框架，利用预训练分割基础模型的解剖先验知识，通过注意力正则化引导分类器关注诊断相关解剖区域，在8种医学影像数据集上提升分类性能并改善注意力可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分类模型应关注诊断相关区域，但标准分类损失缺乏空间监督。显式使用解剖形状信息（如分割掩码）虽有效但标注成本高、计算开销大。旨在无需训练专用分割模型的情况下，利用分割基础模型的定位能力引导分类器注意力。

Method: 提出Locus框架：利用预训练分割基础模型提取解剖形状先验，引入自适应正则化项，平衡前景（解剖区域）与背景区域的注意力，当背景注意力占优时施加惩罚，而非强制执行逐像素对齐。

Result: 在皮肤镜、X光、组织病理学和心脏MRI等8个多样化医学影像数据集上验证，分类性能一致提升，同时注意力更聚焦于解剖相关区域。

Conclusion: 利用分割基础模型可有效替代专用分割模型提供解剖先验，自适应注意力正则化能兼顾分类精度与可解释性，具有跨模态泛化能力。

Abstract: Medical image classification models are ideally expected to identify diagnostically relevant regions while making predictions, yet standard classification losses rarely provide spatial supervision. Explicit supervision via anatomical shape information, such as segmentation masks of task-relevant anatomy, has been shown to guide the network toward regions relevant to the target prediction. However, obtaining such masks incurs substantial manual annotation effort and computational overhead. With the advent of segmentation foundation models that exhibit strong localization of anatomical structures across diverse imaging modalities, we leverage this capability to extract anatomical shape priors without the burden of training a dedicated segmentation model. In this paper, we propose a new framework, Locus, an anatomical attention regularization framework that leverages pretrained segmentation foundation models to guide a classifier's attention toward diagnostically meaningful anatomical structures across diverse imaging modalities. Instead of enforcing pixel-wise alignment with the foundation-model-derived mask, we introduce a regularization term that adaptively balances attention between anatomical (foreground) and background regions, penalizing the classifier when background attention dominates. We validate Locus on eight diverse medical imaging datasets spanning dermoscopy, X-ray, histopathology, and cardiac MRI, showing consistent gains in classification performance alongside improved anatomically grounded attention.

</details>


### [100] [Diversify Diffusion with Temperature Sampling and Variance-Corrective Time Shifting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10853)
*Peizhuo Li,Emre Aksan,Alexandru-Eugen Ichim,Thabo Beeler,Olga Sorkine-Hornung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需重新训练的温度采样方法，通过方差校正的时间偏移（variance-corrective time shifting）解决高温采样导致方差膨胀破坏样本质量的问题，实现了对预训练扩散模型多样性-质量权衡的灵活控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型忠实再现训练分布，但继承了其中的不平衡性，导致稀有或欠代表模式难以采样。高温采样（$p^{(γ)}_0(x) \propto p_0(x)^γ$）可提升稀有模式权重，但朴素的分数量表会导致模态内方差膨胀，破坏逆向扩散过程并降低样本质量。亟需一种无需重新训练的训练自由修复方法。

Method: 提出方差校正时间偏移（variance-corrective time shifting）：查询网络在偏移时间步上的输出，并将所得分数乘以γ，从而在保留模式重加权的同时抵消方差膨胀。此外，温度干预的时间选择可实现粗到细控制：高噪声阶段驱动跨模态组合多样性，低噪声阶段驱动固定组合下的局部外观变化。

Result: 该方法将温度采样转化为预训练扩散和流匹配骨干（DiT、Stable Diffusion、Motion Diffusion）的实用多样性旋钮，无需重新训练，在样本质量和条件保真度的最小代价下取得了一致的多样性提升。

Conclusion: 方差校正时间偏移是一种训练自由、即插即用的技巧，有效解决了高温采样中方差膨胀的问题，为预训练扩散模型提供了可调节的多样性控制手段，且支持粗到细的多层次干预。

Abstract: Diffusion models faithfully reproduce their training distribution, but also inherit its imbalances and leave rare or under-represented modes hard to reach. A natural inference-time remedy is to sample from the high-temperature target $p^{(γ)}_0(x) \propto p_0(x)^γ$ for $0 < γ< 1$, which flattens dominant modes and lifts rare ones. However, naive score scaling while correctly reweighting modes also inflates the per-mode variance, breaking the reverse diffusion process and degrading sample quality. We introduce variance-corrective time shifting, a training-free fix that queries the network at a shifted timestep and scales the resulting score by $γ$, canceling the variance inflation while preserving the mode reweighting. The correction turns simple temperature sampling into a practical diversity knob for pretrained diffusion and flow-matching backbones with no retraining, and we demonstrate consistent gains at minimal cost to sample quality and condition fidelity across DiT, Stable Diffusion and Motion Diffusion models. We further show that the timing of the temperature intervention enables coarse-to-fine control: high-noise stages drive compositional diversity across modes, while low-noise stages drive local appearance variation under a fixed composition.

</details>


### [101] [AU-Guided Synthetic Video Generation for Micro-Expression Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10860)
*Pei-Sze Tan,Sailaja Rajanala,Yee-Fan Tan,Raphael C. -W. Phan,Huey-Fang Ong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EquiME是一个基于AU引导的图像到视频生成技术构建的合成微表情数据集，包含75K视频、15K源图像和5种目标情绪，通过跨数据集实验验证了其作为微表情识别训练资源的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有微表情数据集规模小、人口覆盖窄、情绪标签有限，限制了下游识别性能，亟需更大规模、多样化的数据集。

Method: 采用AU（动作单元）引导的图像到视频生成技术，从15K源人脸图像合成75K微表情视频，覆盖5种目标情绪；同时自动推断人口统计元数据并评估视频质量。

Result: 在SAMM和CASME II上的跨数据集实验中，基于EquiME训练的模型取得了有竞争力的性能，且在四种评估架构上表现出较低的变异度。

Conclusion: EquiME作为合成MER资源是有效的，论文重点介绍了数据集设计、结构化AU条件生成流程及评估证据，项目页面已公开。

Abstract: Micro-expression recognition is limited by the small scale, narrow demographic coverage, and restricted emotion labels of existing datasets. We introduce EquiME, a synthetic micro-expression dataset built from AU-guided image-to-video generation. EquiME contains 75K videos generated from 15K source face images across five target emotions, together with automatically inferred demographic metadata and video-quality measurements. We evaluate EquiME using frame-pair similarity, spatial variation, and no-reference perceptual-quality metrics, together with cross-dataset MER experiments on SAMM and CASME II. Models trained on EquiME achieve competitive cross-dataset performance on SAMM and CASME II and show comparatively low variation across the four evaluated architectures. This paper focuses on the dataset design, the structured AU-conditioning pipeline used for video generation, and the empirical evidence needed to assess EquiME as a synthetic MER resource. Project page: https://kirito-blade.github.io/me-vlm/

</details>


### [102] [X-GuideAR: An Augmented Reality Framework to Mitigate Radiation Exposure during Fluoroscopic Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10873)
*Mingxu Liu,Zixuan Liu,Ruchen Cai,Yu-Chen Ku,Suxi Gu,Amit Jain,Alejandro Martin-Gomez,Mehran Armand*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出X-GuideAR，一种增强现实框架，通过生成合成X射线预览来引导最佳X射线视图获取，减少骨科手术中的辐射暴露。针对S2AI螺钉植入的初步实验显示，X射线使用量减少62.3%，平均安全螺钉直径从5.9mm提升至12.95mm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统骨科手术中，医生需反复进行X射线透视检查（fluoro-hunting）来确保螺钉精准植入，这导致患者和 surgical team 暴露于高剂量辐射。为降低辐射风险同时保证手术精度，亟需一种可提供无辐射引导的替代方案。

Method: X-GuideAR框架通过生成合成X射线预览，在无需实际辐射的情况下加速视图定位。医生根据预览确定所需解剖视图后，仅进行一次真实X射线采集，并将钻孔轨迹预览叠加到该图像上，实现精确螺钉植入。

Result: 针对8条S2AI轨迹的初步实验表明：X射线数量减少62.3%；X-GuideAR支持的平均安全螺钉直径为12.95 mm，传统流程仅为5.9 mm，表明骨包容性改善及潜在生物力学优势。

Conclusion: X-GuideAR在减少辐射暴露和简化S2AI螺钉植入方面展现出巨大潜力，为更安全、高效的骨科手术提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: Achieving optimal screw placement for orthopedic surgeries requires frequent alignment checks and multiple anatomical views under X-ray -- a process known as "fluoro-hunting" that increases radiation exposure to patients and surgical teams. This work introduces X-GuideAR, an augmented reality (AR) framework for identifying optimal X-ray views, aimed at reducing radiation exposure while ensuring accurate screw placement. To exemplify the benefits of X-GuideAR, we focus on S2 alar-iliac (S2AI) screw placement. Our system provides radiation-free guidance for view acquisition and drilling by generating synthetic X-ray previews that accelerate fluoro-hunting. Once the required anatomical views are identified using these previews, a real X-ray is acquired, and the preview of the drilling trajectory is augmented onto it, facilitating precise screw placement with minimal additional radiation. A preliminary study involving eight S2AI trajectories performed by an expert spine surgeon demonstrated a 62.3% reduction in the number of X-rays. Post-procedure evaluations showed that trajectories done with X-GuideAR supported an average safe screw diameter of 12.95 mm compared to 5.9 mm under the conventional workflow, suggesting improved bony containment and potential biomechanical benefit. X-GuideAR shows great potential to reduce radiation exposure and streamline S2AI screw placement, offering a promising direction toward safer and more efficient surgeries.

</details>


### [103] [Design Choices in Splitting-Based Self-Supervised Sparse-View CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10898)
*Nadja Gruber,Lukas Neumann,Ander Biguri,Gyeongha Hwang,Markus Haltmeier,Johannes Schwab*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对自监督稀疏视角CT重建中的关键设计选择（数据划分策略、预处理和推理）缺乏系统研究的问题，提出了一个统一框架，将基于数据划分的重建分解为这三个组件，并扩展了多划分分割和替代推理策略。实验表明，最优划分策略高度依赖于噪声结构：格子划分在独立噪声下表现好，角度掩蔽在相关噪声和真实数据下更鲁棒。多划分分割在多种设置中持续优于纯投影划分。LPIPS和HaarPSI等感知指标揭示了掩蔽策略之间PSNR和SSIM无法体现的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督数据划分方法用于稀疏视角CT重建虽已展现出潜力，但划分策略、预处理和推理等关键设计选择的影响尚未被充分理解，缺乏系统性对比研究。

Method: 提出统一框架将基于数据划分的重建分解为划分策略、预处理和推理三个组件，在此基础上进行受控对比实验，并引入两种增量扩展：多划分分割和替代推理策略。

Result: 最优划分策略取决于测量噪声结构；格子划分在独立噪声下更优，角度掩蔽在相关噪声和真实数据下更鲁棒；多划分分割在多种场景下优于纯投影划分；LPIPS和HaarPSI揭示了掩蔽策略间PSNR和SSIM未捕获的差异。

Conclusion: 为自监督稀疏视角CT重建方法的设计提供了实用指南，并指出了现实成像环境中常见独立性假设的局限性。

Abstract: Self-supervised data splitting has emerged as a promising paradigm for sparse-view CT reconstruction, enabling training from incomplete measurements without fully sampled ground truth. However, the influence of key design choices, including partitioning strategy, preprocessing, and inference, remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce a unified framework that decomposes splitting-based reconstruction into these three components, enabling controlled comparison of existing methods and two incremental extensions: multi-partition splitting and an alternative inference strategy. Experiments on simulated LoDoPaB-CT data under independent and correlated noise, together with validation on the real-world 2DeteCT dataset, show that the optimal partitioning strategy strongly depends on the measurement noise structure. Lattice-based splitting performs favorably under independent noise, whereas angular masking is more robust under correlated noise and real measured data. Multi-partition splitting consistently improves over pure projection-wise splitting in several settings. Complementary perceptual and structural metrics, including LPIPS and HaarPSI, reveal differences between masking strategies that are less apparent from PSNR and SSIM alone. These results provide practical guidelines for designing self-supervised sparse-view CT reconstruction methods and highlight the limitations of common independence assumptions in realistic imaging environments.

</details>


### [104] [DP-Splat: Bayesian Nonparametric Complexity Control for Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10912)
*Aqi Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DP-Splat，用截断的stick-breaking狄利克雷过程先验替代有限对称狄利克雷先验，使3D高斯溅射中占据成分数量K自适应数据，同时保持闭形式坐标上升更新；实验表明DP先验实现复杂度选择，在匹配预算下超越固定K基线+2.7 dB，成分数减少5.9-7.6倍，并揭示了变分实践与后验渐近性之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D高斯溅射方法中，成分数量K由启发式密度控制或用户上限设定，缺乏理论自适应性；变分贝叶斯高斯溅射(VBGS)虽将问题转化为共轭变分推断，但K仍固定不变。本文旨在让K自适应数据，同时保持闭形式更新和理论保证。

Method: 用截断stick-breaking狄利克雷过程先验替代有限对称狄利克雷先验，并作为理论备份提出稀疏过拟合有限狄利克雷先验；所有更新保持闭形式坐标上升步骤；提出自然梯度随机变体使每步成本与数据点数量无关；给出精确单调性保证和截断误差界（纠正了常用的反保守大α近似）。

Result: (i) 有效复杂度K^自适应场景复杂度，在分离良好的合成数据上恢复真实K±1；(ii) DP先验贡献在于复杂度选择而非成分效率——收敛DP拟合在匹配预算下超过单次固定K VBGS +2.7 dB，与充分收敛的固定K基线持平；3D场景中DP-Splat以5.9-7.6倍更少成分匹配或超越VBGS；(iii) 后验预测颜色方差在模型匹配的合成数据上良好校准；(iv) 精确后验渐近建议的排序在平均场坐标上升下反转：DP先验抵抗过度分裂，而稀疏有限混合饱和其截断，这一差距在N三个数量级范围内存在。

Conclusion: DP先验能有效实现场景复杂度自适应选择，减少成分数量同时保持或提升预测性能，但变分实践与后验渐近理论之间存在显著差距，需进一步研究。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting represents scenes as finite mixtures of anisotropic Gaussians whose number of components $K$ is set by heuristic density control or user caps. Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting (VBGS) recast splat fitting as conjugate variational inference, but $K$ remains fixed. We replace the finite symmetric Dirichlet over mixture weights with a truncated stick-breaking Dirichlet-process prior -- and, as a theory-backed alternative, a sparse overfitted finite Dirichlet -- so that the number of occupied components adapts to the data while every update remains a closed-form coordinate-ascent step; a natural-gradient stochastic variant makes the per-step cost independent of the number of points. We give an exact monotonicity guarantee, a rigorous truncation-error bound correcting an anti-conservative large-$α$ approximation in common use, and an honest account of what the fitted number of components estimates. Empirically: (i) the effective complexity $\hat{K}$ adapts to scene complexity and recovers the true $K$ within $\pm 1$ on well-separated synthetic data with regime-appropriate concentration; (ii) a deconfounded comparison shows the DP prior's contribution is complexity selection, not per-component efficiency -- converged DP fits exceed single-pass fixed-$K$ VBGS by +2.7 dB at matched budgets yet tie an equally converged fixed-$K$ baseline, and on 3D scenes DP-Splat matches or exceeds VBGS's held-out color prediction with 5.9-7.6x fewer components; (iii) the posterior-predictive color variance is well calibrated on model-matched synthetic data; and (iv) the ordering suggested by exact-posterior asymptotics reverses under mean-field coordinate ascent: the DP prior resists over-splitting while the sparse finite mixture saturates its truncation, a gap between variational practice and posterior asymptotics documented across three orders of magnitude in $N$.

</details>


### [105] [Unsupervised Detection of Entry and Exit Regions from Vehicle Trajectories for Camera-Agnostic Turning Movement Counts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10949)
*Parikshit Singh Rathore,Vishwajeet Pattanaik,Punit Rathore*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无监督管线，利用目标检测和跟踪提取的车辆轨迹，自动识别交叉口的入口和出口区域，无需人工标注、相机标定或几何先验。通过聚类轨迹的起点和终点生成空间多边形区域，实现对后续轨迹的线性复杂度分类。在25个印度班加罗尔密集异构交通摄像头和UA-DETRAC基准数据集上进行了19,152次管线执行与统计分析，确定了三个关键参数及其推荐配置，中位分类误差约3%。与轨迹聚类基线相比，该方法稳定性更高、计算成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 转向运动计数对交叉口交通管理至关重要，但由于每台摄像头的区域标注成本高昂，其收集仍以人工为主。现有方法依赖人工标注或轨迹聚类，但聚类方法需在每批新数据上重新执行，效率低下。

Method: 提出一个无监督六步管线：(1) 通过目标检测和跟踪提取原始车辆轨迹；(2) 提取轨迹的起点和终点位置；(3) 对这些端点位置进行聚类，生成入口和出口区域多边形；(4) 利用点-in-多边形包含关系，以线性复杂度对后续轨迹进行分类；(5) 配置参数通过系统统计分析（含19,152次管线执行）进行调优；(6) 在25个真实摄像头和UA-DETRAC数据集上验证。

Result: 推荐配置下，中位分类误差约3%（含16个未参与调优的摄像头），GEH值符合工程标准。相比两种轨迹聚类基线，该方法在不同摄像头视角下稳定性更高、计算成本更低，但中位误差略高。校准片段至少60分钟且选择高峰时段可进一步提升区域估计质量。

Conclusion: 该无监督管线可有效替代人工标注实现转向运动计数，具有跨视角泛化能力和低计算成本优势。参数敏感性分析为实际部署提供了经验指导。

Abstract: Turning movement counts are essential for intersection-level traffic management, yet their collection remains predominantly manual due to the cost of per-camera region annotation. This paper presents an unsupervised pipeline that identifies entry and exit regions directly from raw vehicle trajectories extracted via object detection and multi-object tracking, requiring no manual annotation, camera calibration, or prior knowledge of intersection geometry. Unlike trajectory clustering methods that classify individual trajectories using pairwise similarity and must be re-executed on every new batch, the proposed pipeline clusters initial and terminal point locations to produce persistent spatial region polygons that classify future trajectories by point-in-polygon containment at linear cost. The pipeline comprises six sequential steps, each with configurable parameters evaluated through a systematic statistical analysis spanning 19,152 pipeline executions across 25 surveillance cameras capturing dense heterogeneous traffic in Bengaluru, India, and 10 sequences from the UA-DETRAC benchmark dataset. Both parametric and nonparametric testing frameworks identify three consistently significant parameters and yield an empirically grounded recommended configuration. Under this configuration, the pipeline achieves a median classification error of approximately 3% across all 25 cameras, including 16 held-out locations, with GEH values within accepted engineering thresholds. Compared with two trajectory clustering baselines, the proposed pipeline exhibits greater stability across camera views and lower computational cost, at the expense of higher median error.
