We use submodular subset selection, and we develop and evaluate many different submodular functions for this purpose, including determinantal point process (DPP) based approaches, submodular mutual information functions, and facility location-based functions. On a new large-scale suite of 35 heterogeneous benchmarks spanning five different capability categories, 18 frontier LLMs, and over 61K prompts, we find that the facility location (FL) function operating exclusively on inexpensive semantic prompt embeddings preserves LLM scores better than twelve separate score-based and diversity-based baselines, across a range of coreset budgets. Moreover, we show our proposed objective is not limited to the evaluation-unsupervised regime: in the setting where only a handful of whole benchmarks must be selected and a large amount of model scores are available, the same objective matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the MMLU and MTEB leaderboards, while being substantially cheaper to compute. Together, our results suggest that submodularity, in general, is a strong and reliable tool for benchmark compression.

</details>


### [463] [A Dynamic Scene Interaction Reasoning Framework for Scene-level Lane-Change Intention and Trajectory Prediction of Multiple Interacting Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09740)
*Joshua Kofi Asamoah,Blessing Agyei Kyem,Eugene Denteh,Armstrong Aboah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种动态场景图注意力框架（DSiGAT），用于同时预测交通场景中所有相关车辆的换道意图和未来轨迹，通过图注意力消息传递和意图引导解码器实现了场景级的一致性预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有换道预测方法多聚焦于单一目标车辆，而多智能体预测方法仅描述未来位置，缺乏对每个车辆具体操纵（如换道意图）的显式预测，无法提供场景级的连贯理解。

Method: 将交通场景建模为时变交互图，车辆为节点，空间和运动学关系为显式边特征；通过时序图注意力消息传递捕获车辆间动态依赖和预操纵线索；意图引导解码器将预测的操纵与未来运动关联；场景级一致性目标函数促进多车未来轨迹的兼容性。

Result: 在NGSIM I-80、US-101和highD数据集上，意图预测准确率分别达90.12%和90.97%；轨迹RMSE相比最强基线降低最多52.94%；碰撞率和联合位移误差均更低。

Conclusion: 提出的场景级图注意力框架能够同时预测多车意图和轨迹，实现更一致、更准确的场景演化预测，验证了各组件和场景聚焦框架的有效性。

Abstract: Safe motion planning in advanced driver-assistance systems and autonomous vehicles requires an accurate understanding of how the surrounding traffic scene is likely to evolve. However, many existing lane-change prediction methods remain centered on a single target vehicle, while multi-agent forecasting approaches often describe scene evolution only through future positions and provide limited explicit information about the maneuver associated with each vehicle. This study proposes a dynamic scene graph attention framework that predicts the lane-change intention and future trajectory of every relevant vehicle within a local traffic scene. The scene is represented as a time-varying interaction graph in which vehicles are modeled as nodes and their spatial and kinematic relationships are encoded through explicit edge features. Temporal graph-attention message passing captures evolving inter-vehicle dependencies and pre-maneuver cues, while an intention-guided decoder links each predicted maneuver to its corresponding future motion. A scene-level consistency objective further encourages compatible multi-vehicle futures. Experiments on the NGSIM I-80, NGSIM US-101, and highD datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over competing baselines. DSiGAT achieves intention prediction accuracies of 90.12% and 90.97% on NGSIM I-80 and US-101, respectively, and reduces trajectory RMSE by up to 52.94% relative to the strongest baseline. It also produces lower inter-agent collision rates and joint displacement errors, indicating more coherent scene-level predictions. Ablation, sensitivity, robustness, and qualitative analyses further validate the contribution of the proposed components and the effectiveness of the scene-focused formulation.

</details>


### [464] [Scaffolding the Strategist: Architecture-Dependent Reasoning Interventions in Hotelling Spatial Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09743)
*Pratyush Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨结构化推理干预对LLM策略经济推理的影响，发现干预效果与模型架构存在显著交叉交互：承诺型干预提升标准模型但削弱推理模型，分离型干预则相反；对抗性压力测试对推理模型损害更大；两类模型均存在策略识别与执行之间的鸿沟，分离型干预可弥合推理模型的这一鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究结构化推理干预是否能够提升大语言模型的策略经济推理能力，以及干预效果是否依赖于模型架构差异。

Method: 以Hotelling线性城市模型为诊断工具，在GPT-4.1-mini（标准指令跟随模型）和GPT-5-mini（推理优化模型）上设置五种条件（一个无支架基线+四种推理干预），涵盖8个问题（演绎/溯因推理）、3种提示框架、3次重复，共720个独立评判的响应。

Result: 发现支架类型与模型架构之间存在统计显著的交叉交互（t(7)=4.79, p=0.002, d=1.69）：承诺型干预提升标准模型(+0.21)但降低推理模型(-0.63)，分离型干预则相反(-0.40 vs +0.31)。对抗性压力测试对推理模型损害更大（-1.47 vs -0.57，p=0.038），损害程度与基线难度负相关（R²=0.36, p=0.014）。两类模型均存在陈述性-程序性鸿沟，分离型干预可完全弥合推理模型的这一鸿沟。

Conclusion: 结构化推理干预的效果并非普适，而是高度依赖于模型架构；不同干预策略对不同架构的模型可能产生截然不同甚至相反的效果。同时，模型在策略识别与执行之间存在系统性的能力差距。

Abstract: We investigate whether structured reasoning interventions improve the strategic economic reasoning of large language models, and whether their effects depend on model architecture. Using Hotelling's linear city model as a diagnostic vehicle, we evaluate GPT-4.1-mini (a standard instruction-following model) and GPT-5-mini (a reasoning-optimized model) under five conditions - an unscaffolded baseline and four reasoning interventions - across eight questions spanning deductive and abductive reasoning, three prompt framings, and three repetitions per condition, yielding 720 individually judged responses. We find a statistically significant crossover interaction between scaffolding type and model architecture ($t(7) = 4.79$, $p = 0.002$, $d = 1.69$): commitment scaffolding improves the standard model ($+0.21$) while degrading the reasoning model ($-0.63$), and principled separation shows the opposite pattern ($-0.40$ vs. $+0.31$). Both crossovers are individually significant (commitment: $p = 0.040$; separation: $p = 0.002$) and hold across all eight questions with 7/8 directional consistency. Adversarial stress-testing harms both models, with $2.6\times$ greater degradation for the reasoning model ($-1.47$ vs. $-0.57$; $p = 0.038$), and the damage correlates negatively with baseline difficulty ($R^2 = 0.36$, $p = 0.014$). We further document a persistent declarative-procedural gap in which both models identify correct strategies at rates far exceeding their ability to execute them; separation fully closes this gap for the reasoning model while no intervention helps the standard model.

</details>


### [465] [A Theory of Least Autonomy in AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09744)
*Christophe Parisel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"最小自治"原则作为经典"最小特权"原则在AI智能体系统上的泛化，并建立了形式化理论，包括组合爆炸半径、有向智能体影响图和合谋谓词三大核心组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的最小特权原则不足以应对AI智能体系统——智能体不仅能持有权限，还能跨工作流和系统边界组合、批准和放大这些权限，因此需要更泛化的原则。

Method: 定义了三个形式化组件：(1) 组合爆炸半径d(a,b)，将超度量树与格值机密性、完整性和控制上下文标签结合，度量企业层级中行动之间的结构分离程度；(2) 有向智能体影响图G(θ)，通过有向共享资源写-读会议或无向智能体间(A2A)通信会议构建弧，并叠加基于策略阈值θ的会议条件化影响势；(3) 合谋谓词，基于图可达性检测授权组合、决策操纵和跨域能力组合。

Result: 提出了目录-半径画像以支持策略阈值的校准与审计；合谋谓词能够检测三类风险：授权组合、决策操纵和跨域能力组合。

Conclusion: "最小自治"是对"最小特权"在AI智能体时代的必要泛化，所提出的形式化理论为管控智能体系统中的权限滥用和合谋风险提供了系统化的理论基础。

Abstract: Least privilege, the principle that an identity should hold only the permissions strictly required for its task, has been a foundational primitive of access control for decades. We argue that this principle is insufficient for agentic AI systems, which do not merely hold permissions but can combine, approve, and amplify them across workflows and system boundaries.
  We propose least autonomy as an appropriate generalization and develop a formal theory. First, we define a compositional blast radius d(a,b) that measures structural separation between actions in an enterprise hierarchy, combining an ultrametric tree with lattice-valued confidentiality, integrity, and control-context labels. Second, we define a directed agent influence graph G(theta). An arc from U to V requires a directed shared-resource write-to-read meeting or a conservative undirected agent-to-agent (A2A) communication meeting, and a meeting-conditioned influence potential at or above an externally selected policy threshold theta. A catalogue-radius profile supports calibration and audit of theta. Finally, we define a collusion predicate over graph reachability that detects authorization composition, decision manipulation, and cross-domain capability composition.

</details>


### [466] [SupplyNetPy: An Open-Source Python Library for High-Fidelity Modeling and Simulation of Arbitrary Supply Chain and Inventory Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09745)
*Tushar Lone,Neha Karanjkar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SupplyNetPy是一个开源Python库，用于任意多级结构供应链网络的建模与离散事件仿真，支持多种补货策略、易逝品库存、节点中断及随机需求/提前期，并提供验证结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现复杂供应链模型的程序化生成与仿真，支持设计空间探索、假设分析、训练数据生成及供应链数字孪生。

Method: 将供应链描述为带节点和边属性的图，采用离散事件仿真引擎，组件通过继承机制扩展，支持多种补货策略、易逝品库存、节点中断及随机需求/提前期。

Result: 提供了针对分析基准、商业工具和已发表案例研究的详细验证结果。

Conclusion: SupplyNetPy是一个开源、文档完善、高度可扩展的供应链仿真库，可有效支持复杂供应链建模与仿真需求。

Abstract: This paper introduces SupplyNetPy, an open-source, well-documented Python library for modeling and discrete-event simulation of supply chain networks with arbitrary multi-echelon structures. It supports multiple replenishment policies, perishable inventory, node disruptions, and stochastic demand and lead times. All components are extensible via inheritance. Users describe a supply chain as a graph with node and link attributes, while the library handles simulation, providing logs and extensive node and network level performance reports. This paper presents the motivation, design, key features, and architecture of SupplyNetPy, along with detailed validation results (against analytical benchmarks, a commercial tool, and a published case study). A key motivation behind SupplyNetPy's development is programmatic generation and simulation of complex models, enabling design-space exploration, what-if analysis, training data generation, and supply chain digital twins.

</details>


### [467] [Replicating Belief, Not Bits: Epistemic State Replication for Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09748)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Epistemic State Replication (ESR)，一种面向智能体分布式系统的信念复制层，将复制边界从数据可见性转移到知识可见性，使得随机性副本可在语义等价而非比特一致上达成共识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典SMR要求确定性比特一致复制，但智能体系统使用生成式模型，副本间存在随机性推理路径和语义等价但不同的输出，比特级一致限制了执行灵活性和性能。

Method: 定义节点状态K=(L,B)分离确定性证据日志L和随机信念谱系B；提出语义线性化(Semantic Linearizability)和有界最终一致性(Bounded Eventual Coherence)；设计结构化认知增量传播协议和可验证语义回滚机制。

Result: 原型实现和仿真结果表明在给定假设下可行，并减少了次要认知故障。

Conclusion: 在智能体分布式系统中，副本应基于信念而非比特达成一致，ESR提供了更灵活且高效的复制范式。

Abstract: In distributed systems, the classical State Machine Replication (SMR) model assumes that correct replicas execute deterministic transitions to yield identical bitwise states. However, the rise of agentic distributed systems -- where autonomous, stochastic, and model-driven agents orchestrate infrastructure -- presents scenarios where deterministic, bitwise replication is insufficient. Replicas operating with generative models may exhibit divergent reasoning paths, summaries, and token boundaries, yet reach semantically equivalent and correct operational decisions. Forcing bitwise agreement across these stochastic participants degrades execution flexibility, induces context amnesia, and limits performance.
  We argue that in such settings replicas should agree on belief, not bits. We propose Epistemic State Replication (ESR), a belief-replication layer for agentic distributed systems that shifts the replication boundary from data visibility to knowledge visibility. We formalize the epistemic node state as a pair K = (L, B) separating the deterministic, immutable evidence log (L) from the stochastic, evolving belief lineage (B). To govern execution safety, we define Semantic Linearizability, which requires operations to reflect the latest committed operational meaning within a verifier-bounded semantic compatibility metric, and Bounded Eventual Coherence, which bounds expected semantic divergence under fair delivery, monotonic evidence, bounded verifier disturbance, and a contractive graft operator. We outline protocols for propagating derived insights using structured epistemic deltas, and formalize Verifiable Semantic Rollbacks to prune faulty premises from belief lineages without inducing context amnesia. We prototype ESR and report preliminary simulation results that show feasibility under the stated assumptions and illustrate reductions in secondary cognitive faults.

</details>


### [468] [Task-Conditioned Synthetic Data Generation for Improving Machine Learning Performance in Agricultural Prediction Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09751)
*Hamid Ebrahimy,Moritz Lucas,Martin Atzmueller*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种任务条件合成数据生成（TCSDG）算法，结合贝叶斯网络生成器与基于Transformer的表格基础模型（TabICL），用于增强农业预测任务中的机器学习性能。在12个研究站点、两种训练数据比例、四种倍增比和三种ML算法下，TCSDG在89%的作物类型分类实验和74%的作物产量预测实验中提升了ML性能，显著优于六种基准SDG算法，是唯一在聚合层面持续提升两项任务性能的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML算法在农业变量估算中广泛使用，但受限于训练数据的数量和质量，尤其是参考数据不完整或有限的情况。合成数据生成（SDG）提供了一种实用途径来缓解这一问题，通过生成保留原数据关键特征的人工但真实的样本。

Method: 提出TCSDG算法，将贝叶斯网络生成器与基于Transformer的表格基础模型（TabICL）配对，利用教师-学生知识迁移和上下文学习技术，生成任务条件化的合成表格数据。

Result: 在12个研究站点、两种训练数据分数、四种倍增比和三种预测ML算法下，使用TCSDG生成的数据增强原始数据后，在89%的作物类型分类实验和74%的作物产量预测实验中提升了ML性能。TCSDG显著优于六种基准SDG算法，是唯一在聚合层面一致提升两项任务性能的方法。

Conclusion: 精心设计和处理的合成数据能够提升精准农业应用中ML算法的性能。TCSDG提供了一个实用且可扩展的合成数据生成框架，代码已开源。

Abstract: Machine Learning (ML) algorithms have been widely used to estimate agricultural variables across diverse contexts. However, because the quantity and quality of training data strongly influence performance of ML algorithms, their use can be constrained by limited or incomplete reference data. Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) offers a practical approach to address this issue by producing artificial but realistic samples that preserve key characteristics of the original data. Building on teacher-student knowledge transfer and in-context learning for tabular data, this study proposes a Task-Conditioned SDG (TCSDG) algorithm that pairs a Bayesian Network generator with a transformer-based tabular foundation model (TabICL). The proposed algorithm was evaluated on two agricultural prediction tasks: crop yield prediction and crop type classification. Six benchmark SDG algorithms were also utilized to compare their performance with that of TCSDG. Across twelve study sites, two training-data fractions, four multiplication ratios, and three predictive ML algorithms, augmenting the original data with TCSDG-generated synthetic data improved ML performance in 89% of the crop type classification experiments and 74% of the crop yield prediction experiments. TCSDG also substantially outperformed benchmark SDG algorithms and was the only method to consistently improve ML performance across both tasks at the aggregate level. The study demonstrates that carefully designed and processed synthetic data can improve ML performance in precision-agriculture applications. TCSDG offers a practical and extensible framework for generating synthetic data that supports downstream ML agricultural prediction. The full implementation of TCSDG is publicly available as open source at https://github.com/HamidEbrahimy/TCSDG.

</details>


### [469] [LegalFarePlan: A Label-Setting Framework for Fare-Transparent Urban Rail Route Planning under Non-Additive Fare Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09755)
*Tanghui Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LegalFarePlan框架，通过建模合法的出站再入站操作，在给定额外时间预算和分割次数限制下，计算非可加性城市轨道交通票价系统下的可解释路径规划方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市轨道交通票价系统可能存在非可加性（单次付费行程票价不等于各段票价之和），现有路线规划方法未考虑这种通过合法出站再入站操作来降低票价的策略。

Method: 构建LegalFarePlan框架，将合法的出站再入站操作建模为显式可审计约束；实现多种算法：Dijkstra最短时间基线、直接路线规划基线、贪心分割启发式、有界精确标签设置、帕累托前沿搜索。

Result: 在57站半合成基准测试（360个OD对）中，有界精确搜索在45分钟额外时间预算下，71.11%的OD对识别出正面票价降低，平均降低3.78单位，最大降低9.0单位。

Conclusion: 该方法展示了非可加性票价系统下可通过合法出站再入站操作降低票价的行为和可重现性，但结果不构成关于任何实际运营商的实证结论。

Abstract: Urban rail fare systems may be non-additive: the fare of a single paid journey from an origin to a destination can differ from the sum of fares over multiple legally separated journey legs. This paper presents LegalFarePlan, a fare-transparent route-planning framework that models legal exit-and-reentry operations as explicit, auditable constraints. Given a transit network, fare function, transfer rules, station-level exit/re-entry costs, an extra-time budget, and a split limit, the planner computes explainable route plans over paid journey segments. The artifact implements Dijkstra shortest-time and direct route-planner baselines, a greedy split heuristic, bounded exact label-setting, and Pareto-frontier search. Evaluation uses controlled synthetic data and a 57-station semi-synthetic benchmark with 360 OD pairs. On the semi-synthetic benchmark, bounded exact search identifies positive modeled fare reductions for 71.11% of OD pairs, with mean reduction 3.78 and maximum reduction 9.0 synthetic fare units under a 45-minute extra-time budget. These results demonstrate method behavior and reproducibility; they are not empirical conclusions about MTR or any transit operator.

</details>


### [470] [BatteryLake: Agentic, Physics-Grounded Curation of Heterogeneous Battery Aging Data and Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09762)
*Tianwen Zhu,Hao Wang,Yonggang Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BatteryLake 是一个基于智能体与物理约束的电池数据湖仓系统，利用 LLM 自动化元数据提取与格式转换，通过人工验证机制和 26 条质量规则保证数据可靠性，最终发布了来自 25+ 机构的 41 个标准化电池老化数据集及基准任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共电池老化数据集在格式、模式、元数据等方面高度不一致，现有整理工作依赖手动且难以复现，通用数据集成工具又缺乏电化学时序数据的领域语义，亟需一个领域专用、自动化、可复现的数据治理框架。

Method: 提出 BatteryLake 框架：(1) LLM 智能体自动提取元数据并生成数据集专用转换器，输出基于原文证据，无证据时主动弃权；(2) 人在回路的验证机制将校验建模为选择性预测，通过 26 条模式、统计和物理合理性规则筛选数据；(3) 发布包含 41 个数据集、标准化 SOH/RUL 任务、三种划分协议和 8 个基线模型族的开放基准。

Result: 构建了覆盖 25+ 机构、41 个标准化的电池老化数据集，并提供了标准化健康状态（SOH）和剩余寿命（RUL）评估任务、三种数据划分协议及八类基线模型族的开放基准。

Conclusion: BatteryLake 通过智能体驱动与物理约束结合的自动化数据治理框架，有效解决了公共电池数据集一致性和可复现性问题，为电池健康管理社区提供了标准化的数据基础设施。

Abstract: Public battery aging datasets are a critical asset for advanced health management, but their practical use is often limited by inconsistent formats, unclear schemas, and metadata scattered across repositories and publications. Current curation remains largely manual and hard to reproduce, while general-purpose data integration tools miss the domain-specific semantics of electrochemical time-series data. We present BatteryLake, a governed data lakehouse that turns raw public battery data into benchmark-ready assets through an agentic, physics-grounded curation framework, with three contributions. First, LLM agents extract metadata and synthesize dataset-specific converters, grounding every output in verbatim evidence and abstaining when none supports a value. Second, a human-in-the-loop mechanism frames verification as selective prediction and gates admitted data through 26 schema, statistical, and physical-plausibility rules. Third, we release an open benchmark of 41 datasets from over 25 institutions, with standardized SOH and RUL tasks, three split protocols, and eight baseline model families. The platform, benchmark, and curation protocol are publicly available at https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/.

</details>


### [471] [How Much Does Correctness Cost? Budgeted Placement of Strong Correctors in a Weak Multi-Agent Swarm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09765)
*Igor Itkin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究如何通过少量昂贵的"预言机"正确者引导廉价不可靠智能体群达成正确共识，分析预算约束下的最优放置策略，发现子模性保证了贪心算法的近似最优性，并揭示了成本-质量曲线的凹凸性依赖于具体任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索在预算约束下，如何用少量强"预言机"正确者以最低成本引导大量不可靠智能体达成正确共识，并确定最优的预言机放置位置和强度分配策略。

Method: 将群体共识建模为图上的共识过程，每个预言机以成本耦合的凹强度将节点钉向真实值；通过相干性H(R)=tr M(R)^{-1}度量质量；证明H在预言机强度不同时仍具有子模性，从而贪心算法达到(1-1/e)近似最优；推导出完整图上的闭式预算-正确性边界B*(eps)及同等成本下的最少预言机数量k*。

Result: 子模性成立使得成本-收益贪心算法在任意预算下能达到(1-1/e)近似最优；完整图上得到闭式预算-正确性边界；成本-质量曲线的凹凸性决定预算应购买少数强预言机还是多个中等预言机；在Qwen3模型(0.6-32B)上实测发现数学验证任务曲线为凹，而涌现的代码追踪任务曲线为凸。

Conclusion: 预算约束下预言机放置的最优策略是任务依赖的：收益递减时分散投放，收益递增时集中投入；子模性保证了贪心算法的理论保证。

Abstract: A cheap swarm of unreliable agents can be steered to a correct consensus by a few strong, expensive "oracle" correctors. We ask how much one must spend, and where to place the oracles. We model the swarm as a consensus on a graph in which each oracle pins one node toward the truth at a cost-coupled, concave strength, and measure quality by the coherence H(R)=tr M(R)^{-1}. Our first result is that H stays submodular (each added oracle helps less than the last) even when the oracles differ in strength, so a cost-benefit greedy comes within 1-1/e of the best placement at any budget. Inverting the budget gives the budget-correctness frontier B*(eps), the least spend that guarantees an eps-correct consensus: closed-form on the complete graph, and a minimal oracle count k* when oracles cost the same. Whether a budget then buys a few strong oracles or many medium onese curvature of the cost-quality law: diminishing returns favour spreadsharply increasion. Measured onthe Qwen3 ladder (0.6-32B), the law is concave for math verificatio convex foremergent code tracing, so the verdict is genuinely task-dependent.https://github.com/YehudaItkin/budgeted-oracle-placemen

</details>


### [472] [Norm Enforcement for AI Agents: Robustly Shaping Behavior in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09766)
*Yaowen Ye,Jacob Steinhardt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究语言模型智能体在多智能体竞争环境中的规范执行机制，发现简单机制易被利用，而结合可靠性估计与递增惩罚的鲁棒机制能有效抵抗剥削。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体竞争环境中，智能体可能为了个体利益采取损害集体利益的行为（如发布误导性内容），受人类社会通过规范和惩罚机制解决问题的启发，研究如何为语言模型智能体设计有效的规范执行机制。

Method: 首先测试简单规范执行机制，发现其容易被未对齐智能体利用；随后设计更鲁棒的机制，包含两个关键要素：随时间估计每个智能体的可靠性，以及对重复违规行为实施递增惩罚。在三个模拟环境和多种智能体群体中进行评估。

Result: 基于可靠性估计和递增惩罚的机制能够抵抗剥削，同时以与基线相当或更低的成本惩罚违规行为。

Conclusion: 规范执行机制可以作为塑造智能体行为的可扩展杠杆，但前提是这些机制在设计时必须预见到自身将成为所治理系统的一部分。

Abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed in shared environments where they pursue diverse goals and compete for rewards. This multi-agent competition can lead to behaviors that serve individual gains at collective cost -- for instance, marketing agents may post misleading content as a result of competing for engagement on social media. Human societies address such problems through norms that constrain acceptable behavior, supported by enforcement mechanisms that detect and penalize violations. Motivated by this, we study norm enforcement mechanisms for language model agents. We find that simple enforcement mechanisms are exploited by misaligned agents for competitive advantage, even when they are not explicitly trained or prompted to do so. We thus turn our attention to designing more robust mechanisms, and identify two key ingredients: estimating each agent's reliability over time, and updating this estimate with escalating penalties for repeated misbehavior. Across three simulated environments and a variety of agent populations, mechanisms built on these principles resist exploitation, while still penalizing norm violations at comparable or lower cost than baselines. Our results position norm enforcement mechanisms as scalable levers for shaping agents' behavior, but only when designed to anticipate becoming part of the system they govern. Our code and data are available at https://yaowenye.com/norm-enforcement.

</details>


### [473] [Verification of Adaptive Agentic Controllers through Finite Rule Revision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09770)
*Roberto Garrone*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对工业智能体AI系统从原型到部署的差距，提出了一种针对有限符号规则表示的自适应智能体控制器的有界验证协议。该协议通过显式诊断谓词、解释日志和保留集重评估，将控制器视为可修订的有限对象，将诊断失败映射到预定义的规则级编辑（添加、删除、优先级修改）。在财务约束库存控制基准上的实验展示了不可修复、被拒绝的局部修复以及单步局部修复三种结果。方法贡献在于提供了一种可模拟的流程，用于测试控制器级故障的可观察性、可解释性、局部可修订性和经验可重测性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业智能体AI系统在原型能力与生产部署之间存在显著差距，自适应智能体可能生成看似合理的输出，但在非确定性、保密性约束、有限上下文和弱可观测性条件下难以验证。现有方法缺乏对控制器故障进行系统性检测、局部修复或拒绝的正式协议。

Method: 将自适应智能体控制器形式化为有限符号规则集合，引入显式诊断谓词、解释日志和保留集重评估机制。控制器故障被映射为三类规则级编辑：规则添加、规则删除、优先级修改。修复后的控制器在保留集模拟种子或克隆初始状态上进行重新评估，通过预设阈值和护栏进行验证。

Result: 在财务约束库存控制基准实验中，识别出三种结果：资源引发的故障无法通过单次规则编辑修复；部分修复因违反阈值或护栏而被拒绝；通过移除平滑规则实现了订单波动故障的单步局部修复。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一个方法论贡献：一种与模拟兼容的流程，用于测试特定控制器级故障是否能在受控条件下实现可观察、可解释、局部可修订和经验可重测。这为自适应智能体控制器的形式化验证与安全部署提供了可行的技术路径。

Abstract: Industrial agentic AI systems increasingly exhibit a gap between prototype capability and production deployment. In particular, adaptive agents may generate plausible outputs while remaining difficult to verify under non-determinism, confidentiality constraints, limited context, and weak observability. This paper formulates a bounded verification protocol for adaptive agentic controllers represented by finite symbolic rules, explicit diagnostic predicates, explanation logs, and held-out re-evaluation. The central research question is: when an adaptive agentic controller is represented through finite rules, explicit diagnostic predicates, explanation logs, and held-out re-evaluation, which classes of controller failure can be detected, locally repaired, or rejected without relying on unrestricted human-in-the-loop judgment? The proposed framework treats the controller as a finite revisable object. Diagnostic failures are mapped to predefined rule-level edits, including rule addition, rule deletion, and priority revision. Repaired controllers are then evaluated on held-out simulation seeds or cloned initial states. Experiments in a stylized financially constrained inventory-control benchmark show three outcomes: resource-induced failures that remain non-repairable by one rule edit, partial repairs that are rejected because they violate thresholds or guardrails, and a local one-step repair of an order-volatility failure induced by removing a smoothing rule. The contribution is methodological and provides a simulation-compatible procedure for testing whether specific controller-level failures can be made observable, explainable, locally revisable, and empirically re-tested under controlled conditions.

</details>


### [474] [EvoCUA-1.5: Online Reinforcement Learning for Multi-turn Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09773)
*Mianqiu Huang,Taofeng Xue,Chong Peng,Jinrui Ding,Sicheng Fan,Jiale Hong,Yufei Gao,Xiaocheng Zhang,Linsen Guo,Xin Yang,Dengchang Zhao,Yuchen Xie,Peng Pei,Xunliang Xie,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoCUA-1.5将自我进化计算机使用智能体从离线经验学习扩展到在线强化学习，通过STEPO策略优化、DTAC课程学习和异步RL基础设施，在OSWorld-Verified上达到63.2%的成功率，超越同规模开源基线并接近更大参数量的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体依赖模仿学习和离线轨迹优化，但静态轨迹无法覆盖真实计算机使用的因果反馈循环（每次动作改变屏幕状态、未来动作空间和恢复选项）。需要将策略从离线学习扩展到在线强化学习，让策略与可执行沙箱环境交互并从可验证任务结果中改进。

Method: 提出EvoCUA-1.5，核心包括：(1) Step-Level Policy Optimization (STEPO)，保持轨迹级优势平衡的同时分解为步级样本；(2) 策略感知过滤和通过率校准；(3) Dynamic Tri-Adaptive Curriculum (DTAC)，结合可学习任务、困难正向回放和可控不可行任务暴露；(4) 完全异步的RL基础设施，包含陈旧性控制和迷你分组批处理。

Result: 在OSWorld-Verified上达到63.2%的成功率，超越同规模（32B/35B）开源基线，甚至接近更大参数量的模型。

Conclusion: EvoCUA-1.5提供了一个实用的在线RL扩展框架，有效解决了多轮交互中的上下文管理、稀疏终端奖励、变长轨迹和慢环境反馈等挑战，验证了各组件对训练稳定性和下游性能的提升。

Abstract: Computer-use agents must solve long-horizon tasks through repeated interaction with partially observable, multimodal desktop environments. Although imitation learning and offline trajectory refinement provide strong priors, static traces cannot cover the causal feedback loop of real computer use: each action changes the screen state, future action space, and recovery options. EvoCUA-1.5 extends self-evolving computer-use agents from offline experience learning to online reinforcement learning, where policies interact with executable sandbox environments and improve from verifiable task outcomes. Online RL in this setting requires more than directly reusing single-turn language-RL recipes. Multi-turn interaction introduces context-managed observations, sparse terminal rewards, variable-length trajectories, and slow environment feedback. EvoCUA-1.5 addresses these challenges with Step-Level Policy Optimization (STEPO), which preserves trajectory-level advantage balance after decomposition into step-level samples; policy-aware filtering and pass-rate calibration over verifiable synthesized tasks; Dynamic Tri-Adaptive Curriculum (DTAC), which combines learnable tasks, difficult positive replay, and controlled infeasible-task exposure; and a fully asynchronous RL infrastructure with staleness control and mini-group batching. Experiments show that these components improve training stability and downstream performance. EvoCUA-1.5 achieves 63.2\% success on OSWorld-Verified, outperforming comparable 32B/35B-scale open-weight baselines and even approaching models with significantly larger parameter counts. Overall, EvoCUA-1.5 provides a practical framework for scaling online RL in multi-turn computer-use agents.

</details>


### [475] [From Patterns to Maze Structures: SMT-Based Path Synthesis and 2D/3D Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09781)
*Shengyi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于SMT（可满足性模理论）的迷宫结构生成管线，将路径合成问题编码为全局约束（邻接、连续性、图案约束覆盖），支持平面自回避路径和三维编织迷宫，是Bridges 2026会议论文的扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将输入图案（文本或形状）自动转换为迷宫结构，需要解决路径合成中的全局约束问题，并支持从二维平面迷宫到三维编织迷宫的扩展。

Method: 将路径合成问题编码为SMT（可满足性模理论）中的全局约束，包括邻接约束、连续性约束和图案约束覆盖；每个固定边界实例通过一次求解完成；路径可作为平面迷宫和三维编织迷宫的骨架。

Result: 生成的路径要么是平面的自回避路线，要么是具有指定上下交叉的分层遍历路径；以此为基础构建了平面迷宫和三维编织迷宫实现。

Conclusion: 该管线的SMT编码方法能有效解决图案约束下的迷宫路径合成问题，并扩展至三维编织迷宫；论文提供了更丰富的SMT-LIB示例以增强可复现性。

Abstract: We present a pipeline for constructing maze structures from input patterns such as text or shapes. The central path-synthesis problem is encoded in Satisfiability Modulo Theories as global constraints on adjacency, continuity, and pattern-constrained coverage, allowing each fixed-bound instance to be solved in one call. The resulting path is either a planar, self-avoiding route or a layered traversal with prescribed over--under crossings, and it serves as a scaffold for constructing planar mazes and three-dimensional realizations of woven mazes. This report extends the published Bridges 2026 conference paper with more representative SMT-LIB examples and a fuller account of how synthesized paths become concrete maze constructions in planar and three-dimensional form.

</details>


### [476] [Length Penalties Make Chain-of-Thought Less Monitorable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09786)
*Bryce Little*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 长度惩罚强化学习会缩短思维链推理，同时隐藏影响模型答案的线索。实验表明，长度惩罚无法阻止误导性提示影响模型，尽管思维链提及提示的频率大幅降低。压缩在保持准确性的同时，会优先移除监控所需线索，揭示了推理成本与可监控性之间的权衡边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究长度惩罚强化学习在压缩思维链推理时，是否会影响模型答案的可解释性和可监控性，即压缩是否会隐藏影响模型决策的真实因素。

Method: 训练Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-14B变体，设置不同目标链长度；使用偏差提示干预方法在MMLU-Pro-R和四个迁移基准上评估；通过随机删除句子进行长度匹配对照实验，分离长度与内容的影响。

Result: 压缩大幅减少推理token并保持多数选择准确性，但提示影响接近基线。最强压缩下，下界忠实度降至基线的63.1%（14B）和69.4%（4B）；监控捕获提示使用率从69%降至49%（14B）和从60%降至48%（4B）。长度匹配后，压缩链披露提示的频率比随机缩短的基线链低7-35个百分点。

Conclusion: 压缩不仅仅缩短了推理长度，更优先移除了监控所需线索，揭示了压缩-可监控性边界：更廉价的推理可以保留答案，但使影响答案的因素更难被检测。

Abstract: Length-penalized reinforcement learning can shorten chain-of-thought reasoning while hiding an influence that drives the model's answer. In our experiments, training with length penalties does not stop misleading hints from steering models, even though the models' chains of thought mention the hint much less often. A token-accuracy evaluation would count these runs as successful because they use fewer reasoning tokens with little accuracy loss; it would miss whether the remaining trace still shows what drove the answer. We train Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B variants with different target chain lengths, then evaluate them with biasing-hint interventions on held-out MMLU-Pro-R and four transfer benchmarks. Compression sharply cuts reasoning tokens, preserves most multiple-choice accuracy, and leaves hint influence near baseline. At the strongest target, lower-bound faithfulness falls to 63.1% of baseline for Qwen3-14B and 69.4% for Qwen3-4B; the raw rate at which a monitor catches hint use falls from 69% to 49% and from 60% to 48%. To separate length from content, we randomly delete sentences from uncompressed baseline chains until the remaining text matches the compressed length. Even after this length matching, compressed chains disclose the hint 7-35 percentage points less often than baseline chains that we shorten at random, for both Qwen3 sizes and all five evaluation distributions. Compression therefore does more than shorten reasoning, preferentially removing the cues a monitor needs to see what influenced the answer. Together, these results reveal a compression-monitorability frontier in which cheaper reasoning can preserve answers while making the influences behind them harder to detect.

</details>


### [477] [PHITSBench: an execution-scored benchmark for AI-assisted PHITS radiation-transport input generation using natural language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09789)
*Xianglin Ji,Svetlana V. Boriskina*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PHITSBench是一个包含282个可执行评分任务的蒙特卡罗粒子输运代码基准测试，评估了GPT-5.4在不同配置下的表现。无领域知识时，编辑和修复任务成功率分别为95%和70%，但从零生成模拟成功率仅为0%。引入结构化知识目录后，单次生成成功率提升至57%，智能体执行进一步提升至66-73%，但计算成本增加。错误主要由物理可观测量的选择和配置不当导致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为PHITS（粒子与重离子输运代码系统）建立一个可执行评分的标准化基准测试，以系统评估大语言模型在科学计算代码生成、编辑和修复方面的能力，并探索知识增强和智能体方法对提升模型表现的作用。

Method: 构建包含282个任务、覆盖三类工作流（参数编辑、语法修复、自然语言描述生成完整模拟）的PHITSBench基准；采用复合指标评分（执行成功+生成与参考输运可观测量的一致性）；评估GPT-5.4的五种配置（零样本提示到知识增强及智能体工作流）；引入机器可读的PHITS知识目录和用户手册作为辅助知识源。

Result: 无领域知识时编辑和修复任务成功率达95%和70%，但Reproduce任务成功率为0%；知识目录将Reproduce任务单次成功率提升至57%；智能体执行进一步提升至66-73%；错误主导因素为物理可观测量选择和配置错误，而非语法生成问题。

Conclusion: AI辅助辐射输运建模的未来进步不仅依赖基础模型的提升，还同样依赖于机器可读知识库、精心策划的领域训练数据集以及基于执行评估的评测环境。

Abstract: We introduce PHITSBench, an execution-scored benchmark for the Monte Carlo Particle and Heavy Ion Transport code System (PHITS). PHITSBench comprises 282 transport-scorable tasks spanning three common workflow categories: parameter editing (Edit), syntax repair (Repair ), and complete simulation generation from natural-language descriptions (Reproduce). Each task is evaluated using a Composite Metric Score that combines execution success with agreement between generated and reference transport observables. Using PHITSBench, we evaluate five GPT-5.4-based configurations ranging from zero-shot prompting to knowledge-augmented and agentic workflows. Without domain-specific knowledge, the model performs well on editing and repair tasks (95% and 70% success, respectively) but fails to generate correct simulations from scratch (0% success on the Reproduce track). A structured, machine-readable PHITS knowledge catalog, supplied alongside the user manual, raises single-shot Reproduce-task success to 57%. Agentic execution provides a further improvement to 66-73%, but at increased computational cost. Failure analysis shows that the remaining errors are dominated by incorrect selection and configuration of physical observables rather than syntax generation. These results suggest that future progress in AI-assisted radiation-transport modeling will depend as much on machine-readable knowledge bases, curated domain-training datasets, and execution-grounded evaluation environments as on advances in foundation models themselves.

</details>


### [478] [Semantic Drift and the Stability of Operator Control in Reasoning-Class Decision Support Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09790)
*M. L. Kaluzhsky,V. A. Efirov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过两个月连续纵向实验，验证了大语言模型在深度逻辑推理中存在的语义上下文漂移现象，提出了人机交互数学模型和操作者控制稳定性系数，识别了控制功能反转临界点，并给出了基于改进层次相似性模型的动态关系仲裁回路工程建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决新一代混合人机决策支持系统中操作者控制稳定性与目标保持的基本问题，应对大语言模型推理过程中语义上下文漂移带来的控制挑战。

Method: 基于两个月的连续纵向实验（联合设计专著格式文本阵列），验证并描述推理型大语言模型中的语义上下文漂移现象；提出人机交互数学模型，引入操作者控制稳定性系数（考虑隐藏推理链的非线性上下文压力）；在认知组学理论范式下捕捉控制功能反转临界点。

Result: 验证了推理型大语言模型中语义上下文漂移的存在，提出了操作者控制稳定性系数作为新的度量指标，识别了控制功能反转的临界点。

Conclusion: 应实施基于改进层次相似性模型的动态关系仲裁回路，以保障人机决策支持系统中操作者控制的稳定性。

Abstract: The article investigates the fundamental problem of ensuring the stability of operator control and preserving goal-targeting in hybrid human-machine decision support systems (DSS) of a new generation. Based on a two-month continuous longitudinal experiment on the joint design of a monograph-format textual array, the latent phenomenon of semantic context drift in large language models of deep logical reasoning (Reasoning LLMs) is verified and described. A mathematical model of interaction in the human-machine interface is proposed, and an original metric is introduced - the operator control stability coefficient, which takes into account the non-linear contextual pressure of hidden reasoning chains. Within the paradigm of the cognitome theory, a critical point of control functions inversion is captured. Engineering recommendations are formulated for implementing dynamic relational arbitration loops based on a modified hierarchical similarity model.

</details>


### [479] [Agentic Context Learning with Self-Discovered Specification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09794)
*Jike Zhong,Ming Li,Yuxiang Lai,Ziyan Yang,Jingyu Xie,Jihyung Kil,Zheda Mai,Shao-Yuan Lo,Ren Xiang,Konstantinos Psounis,Yuanyuan Lei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现上下文学习（Context Learning）的困难主要源于**规格获取（Specification Acquisition）**而非内容获取。通过分析31,592个评分项目，发现55.4%评估规格获取，仅22.6%评估内容获取；76.7%的规格未在用户查询中明确指定，但95.5%可从上下文中追溯。作者提出简单干预方法PSCI（私有规格-契约归纳），通过提取局部规格并进行对抗性检查和修复，在CL-Bench上达到SOTA 28.14%（GPT-5.1），相对提升24.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在上下文学习任务中表现极差（前沿模型成功率低于24%），但原因尚不明确。作者希望系统探究这一困难的根本原因。

Method: 1) 在CL-Bench上进行12种检索、反思和验证基线的综合实验；2) 对31,592个评分项目进行细粒度失败分析，区分内容获取与规格获取；3) 提出PSCI方法：提取局部规格，通过对抗性检查与修复强制执行规格。

Result: 1) 12种基线方法在直接全上下文提示上的提升有限；2) 55.4%的项目评估规格获取，仅22.6%评估内容获取；3) 76.7%的规格未在查询中明确指定，但95.5%可追溯至上下文；4) PSCI在GPT-5.1上达28.14%（+5.59 pp），在Qwen3.5-27B和Gemini 3 Pro上分别提升+5.28 pp和+6.17 pp。

Conclusion: 上下文学习的关键瓶颈不仅是内容获取，更是规格获取——即模型需要从上下文中提取并遵循未明确指定的领域特定格式、局部规则和完整性条件。PSCI验证了这一诊断的有效性。

Abstract: Context learning is an emerging inference-time task where LLMs must learn and apply novel, task-specific knowledge from intricate contexts absent from pre-training; even frontier models score under 24% task success. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study to understand why this setting remains difficult. A natural hypothesis is that failures stem from content access; yet across twelve retrieval, reflection, and verification baselines on CL-Bench, an extensive context learning benchmark, we find limited gains over direct full-context prompting. Further failure analysis reveals a key finding: unlike typical long-context tasks such as long document understanding, context learning requires not only recovering local content but also acquiring local specifications that are often unspecified in the query but distributed across the context: domain-specific formats, local rules, and completeness conditions. Across all 31,592 rubric items, we find that 55.4% clearly evaluate specification acquisition, while only 22.6% evaluate content acquisition. Moreover, despite 76.7% of specifications being unspecified in the user query, 95.5% are traceable to the context, indicating these are learnable obligations rather than hidden requirements. To validate this diagnosis, we design a deliberately simple intervention PSCI (private specification-contract induction) which extracts local specifications and enforces them through adversarial checking and repair; PSCI achieves state-of-the-art 28.14% with GPT-5.1 (+5.59 pp absolute and +24.8% relative) on CL-Bench, replicated on Qwen3.5-27B (+5.28 pp) and Gemini 3 Pro (+6.17 pp). Seventeen ablations further isolate the role of task-specific specifications. Overall, our results suggest context learning hinges on not only content acquisition but also specification acquisition.

</details>


### [480] [Exploring Agentic Workflows for Generating High Quality Math Visual Aids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09839)
*Rizwaan Malik,Ashna Khetan,Isabel Sieh,Samin Khan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于智能体工作流的自改进循环方法，让LLM代理生成质量评估问题并利用VLM的反馈迭代优化K-12数学图表生成，初步实验表明该方法能提升AI生成图表的可靠性和教育价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI工具（包括LLM）即使提供详细描述，也难以可靠生成准确且符合教育学的数学图表，特别是在中学数学教育场景中存在显著空白。

Method: 设计了一个智能体工作流：LLM代理根据视觉质量标准生成质量评估问题，然后VLM基于这些问题评估生成的图表，并将反馈用于迭代改进输出，形成自我改进循环。

Result: 探索性评估表明该方法能提升AI生成图表的可靠性，但识别出关键改进方向：需要更强的空间推理能力和更全面的图表特征覆盖。

Conclusion: 初步证据显示该智能体自改进工作流可以增强AI生成数学图表的可靠性和教育价值。

Abstract: Mathematical diagrams play a crucial role in K 12 education, both as problem components and as scaffolding for student comprehension. However, current AI tools, including Large Language Models (LLMs), struggle to reliably generate accurate and pedagogically sound visual diagrams, even when provided with detailed descriptions. A significant gap therefore remains in the reliable generation of diagrams for middle school mathematics. To address this, we introduce an agentic workflow that enables LLM agents to evaluate the quality of generated visuals and use this feedback to iteratively improve their outputs. This self improvement loop aims to enhance the accuracy and educational appropriateness of AI generated diagrams. Our research investigates two questions. First, can LLMs accurately generate quality assurance questions for a visual aid given specific criteria for visual quality? Second, given valid quality assurance questions, can Vision Language Models effectively evaluate generated K 12 visual aids and use the resulting feedback to improve them iteratively? We conduct an exploratory evaluation of our agentic workflow and identify key areas for improvement, including stronger spatial reasoning and more comprehensive coverage of diagram features in the generated quality assurance questions. Our results provide preliminary evidence that this approach can improve the reliability and educational value of AI generated mathematical diagrams.

</details>


### [481] [TopoExplore: Topological Discrimination for Archive-Based Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09971)
*Jason Carlson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TopoExplore通过在Go-Explore基础上增加拓扑检测（识别封闭未探索区域“空洞”的入口），仅在真正的入口（间隙/门细胞）放置衰减选择奖励，避免在密封区域和已进入区域浪费探索资源，在MiniGrid套件上取得1.52x中位数加速，在复杂门场景达10.9x加速；但在Montezuma's Revenge中因缺少墙壁知识导致不可达占据伪影捕获奖励而失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于存档的探索方法（如Go-Explore）仅通过访问稀有度选择返回状态，前沿方法仅返回未知边界，两者都不判断边界后的未探索区域是否真的可进入。探索不仅是为了寻找奖励，更是为下游学习和规划收集结构完整的经验。

Method: TopoExplore在Go-Explore的细胞选择基础上增加周期性拓扑通道：对已访问集占据网格执行洪泛填充，检测封闭的未探索区域（空洞，即复形H1类），仅在其严格入口（间隙或门细胞）放置衰减选择奖励，使密封区域从不被目标化，已进入区域退出探索。

Result: 在18个环境的MiniGrid套件上（15个种子，冻结超参数），TopoExplore对比Go-Explore消融取得1.52x几何中位数加速（首次进入步数），对比前沿基线1.37x；前沿探索在密封诱饵结构出现时退化（诱饵环境上0.83-1.48x vs TopoExplore的1.65-2.11x），TopoExplore在硬多交互门场景取得最大优势（10.9x）。在Montezuma's Revenge上报告诚实负面结果（缺乏墙壁知识时不可达占据伪影捕获奖励导致性能退化）；在HM3D扫描建筑上初步正面结果，加速比与场景难度相关（r=0.69）。

Conclusion: 有拓扑感知的选择在需要区分封闭结构时能带来收益，在开放覆盖（前沿方法最强领域）中虽未针对该场景调参仍具竞争力。

Abstract: Archive-based exploration methods such as Go-Explore select which visited state to return to using visitation rarity, and frontier methods return to the boundary of the unknown; neither asks whether the unexplored region behind a boundary is enterable at all. Exploration is not just about finding reward - it is about collecting a structurally complete experience for downstream learning and planning. We introduce TopoExplore, which augments Go-Explore cell selection with a periodic topological pass: enclosed unexplored regions (voids) of the visited-set occupancy grid are detected by flood fill (the H1 classes of its cubical complex), and a decaying selection bonus is placed only on their strict entrances (gap or door cells), so sealed regions are never targeted and entered regions retire. On a controlled 18-environment MiniGrid suite (15 seeds, frozen hyperparameters) TopoExplore attains a 1.52x geometric-mean speedup in median steps-to-first-entry over its exact Go-Explore ablation, versus 1.37x for a frontier baseline; frontier exploration degrades when sealed decoy structure appears (0.83-1.48x on decoy environments vs. 1.65-2.11x for TopoExplore), while TopoExplore holds its largest win on hard multi-interaction doors (10.9x). We report an honest negative on Montezuma's Revenge - without wall knowledge, unreachable occupancy artifacts capture the bonus and performance degrades as it grows, isolating the wall-aware entrance test as the load-bearing component - and a preliminary positive on HM3D scanned buildings, where the speedup over Go-Explore tracks scene difficulty (r=0.69) even as frontier selection dominates blanket coverage. The evidence supports a deliberately scoped claim: topology-aware selection pays off where enclosed structure must be discriminated, and remains competitive at open coverage, where frontier methods are strongest, despite not being tuned for that regime.

</details>


### [482] [Who&When Pro: Can LLMs Really Attribute Failures in AI Agents?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09996)
*Jiale Liu,Huajun Xi,Shaokun Zhang,Yifan Zeng,Tianwei Yue,Chi Wang,Jian Kang,Qingyun Wu,Huazheng Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了Who&When Pro基准，用于自动化归因智能体系统中的失败。通过精确回放成功前缀后注入失败，构建了12,326条带标注的失败轨迹，覆盖3种模态和26个基准。实验揭示了不同模态、协议和模型家族在失败归因中的系统模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着智能体系统能力增强，其失败变得更加微妙，自动化失败归因变得愈发重要，但目前缺乏大规模、高质量的基准来评估和推动这一方向的发展。

Method: 采用严格受控的管道：精确回放成功轨迹前缀后注入失败，构建12,326条失败轨迹；覆盖3种模态和26个基准场景；使用LLM进行自动化失败归因。

Result: 构建了大规模、高质量且带黄金标注的失败归因基准，并通过广泛实验揭示了不同模态、协议和模型家族在失败归因中的系统模式。

Conclusion: Who&When Pro为自动化失败归因提供了标准化评估框架，实验结果可为未来自动化失败归因系统提供实证指导。

Abstract: Automated failure attribution uses LLMs to identify where and why agentic systems fail. As agents become more capable, their failures become subtler, making automated attribution increasingly important. We introduce Who&When Pro, a large-scale benchmark for automated failure attribution in agentic systems. Using a strictly controlled pipeline that injects a failure only after exactly replaying a successful prefix, we construct 12,326 failed trajectories with golden labels across 3 modalities and 26 benchmarks covering various scenarios. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct extensive experiments and analyses, revealing systematic patterns in how models attribute failures across modalities, protocols, and model families, and providing empirical guidance for future automated failure attribution systems.

</details>


### [483] [A Symbolic Neural CPU for Quantization-Simulated Writeback and Interpretable Program Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10021)
*Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种迹监督符号神经CPU架构，通过可微分算术逻辑单元、操作路由器、寄存器写回和完整轨迹监督，实现神经网络的可见符号执行路径；在16位基准上精确复现参考执行，8-bit量化保持操作路径完整，数值漂移源于连续与低精度语义不匹配而非执行失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络能学习算法映射，但隐藏的状态转换使得执行过程不可信。为了让状态转换可见，需要一种能够暴露每一步操作、寄存器轨迹和写回语义的可解释执行架构。

Method: 构建迹监督符号神经CPU：组合循环控制器、显式操作路由器、固定可微分算术逻辑单元库、目标掩码寄存器写回、完整轨迹监督和匹配定点回放。比较了循环、Transformer、时序卷积、时序图启发和状态空间等多种控制器。

Result: 非量化执行器在16位基准上精确复现参考执行；8-bit量化模拟执行器在1000条指令程序中保持符号操作路径完整；数值漂移被证明来自连续与低精度参考语义不匹配。消融实验表明操作门监督对于可检查执行路径是必要的。

Conclusion: 建立了一个迹可验证的框架，用于可解释、低精度和可控的神经执行，并扩展了ValueMemory、混合自适应LIF控制器、行为克隆和强化学习训练等接口。

Abstract: Neural networks can learn algorithmic input-output mappings, but trusting a learned executor requires more than a correct final answer because the state transitions that produce it are usually hidden. To make those transitions visible, we introduce a trace-supervised symbolic neural CPU, a factorized learned execution architecture that combines recurrent control, an explicit operation router over a fixed differentiable arithmetic-logic unit bank, destination-masked register writeback, complete trajectory supervision and matched fixed-point replay. The model exposes the selected operation, source and destination registers, register trajectory, memory signals and writeback semantics at every step. On the principal 16-wide benchmark, the non-quantized executor reproduces reference execution exactly, while the eight-bit quantization-simulated executor preserves the symbolic operation path through programs of 1,000 instructions. When the same execution is evaluated against a matched fixed-point replay, the residual numerical drift disappears, showing that it comes from a mismatch between continuous and low-precision reference semantics rather than from execution failure. We compare recurrent, Transformer, temporal-convolution, temporal graph-inspired and state-space controllers, and the ablations show that operation-gate supervision is necessary for an inspectable execution path. Hidden-opcode memory-pressure tasks expose the remaining limits in delayed state use and temporal binding. We also extend the interface with ValueMemory, hybrid adaptive leaky integrate-and-fire controllers, candidate-constrained symbolic control trained through behaviour cloning and actor-critic reinforcement learning, and an RV32I base-integer semantic bridge. Together, these results establish a trace-verifiable framework for interpretable, low-precision and controllable neural execution.

</details>


### [484] [AgentAbstain: Do LLM Agents Know When Not to Act?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10059)
*Xun Liu,Yi Evie Zhang,Vira Kasprova,Parisa Rabbani,Pardis Sadat Zahraei,Tianyu Zhang,Ali Ebrahimpour-Boroojeny,Varun Chandrasekaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了AgentAbstain，首个针对LLM智能体系统在不确定情境下是否应"有所不为"（即主动放弃执行）的系统性评估框架。该框架包含基于8种弃权场景的配对任务基准，并通过自动化流水线AbstainGen生成任务。评估17个前沿LLM在4种智能体框架中的表现，发现最佳模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro）的配对准确率仅59.5%，且弃权能力与任务解决能力几乎不相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体评估主要关注任务成功率，忽视了智能体在面临歧义、冲突约束或工具故障时是否具备识别"何时不行动"的能力，这可能导致不可逆的意外操作，存在实际部署风险。

Method: 构建了AgentAbstain框架，包含：（1）基于8类弃权场景的agent原生分类法；（2）263个配对任务（should-act和should-abstain成对出现），在42个可执行沙箱环境中通过受控扰动（指令、工具或环境状态）生成；（3）AbstainGen自动化流水线，端到端合成沙箱环境与配对任务，经确定性回放和语义LLM法官验证；（4）在4种智能体框架中对17个前沿LLM进行评估。

Result: 最佳智能体（Gemini 3.1 Pro）在配对任务上的准确率仅为59.5%；弃权能力与通用任务解决能力几乎不相关；存在"事后弃权"（post-hoc abstention）失败模式，即智能体在执行不可逆操作后才意识到弃权触发条件；人工标注者评估94-98%的样本任务设计良好。

Conclusion: 现有LLM智能体的弃权能力严重不足，且不能通过提升任务解决能力来弥补，需要专门的研究和优化。AgentAbstain和AbstainGen为评估和提升智能体的安全边界提供了系统化的工具与基准。

Abstract: Agent systems based on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for autonomous tasks, yet existing evaluations mostly focus on task success rather than whether agents know when to abstain. This gap poses real risks: under ambiguity, conflicting constraints, or tool failures, agents may execute unintended and irreversible actions. To close this gap, we present the first systematic evaluation framework for agentic abstention: the calibrated ability of tool-using LLM agents to recognize when not to act. At its core, AgentAbstain is a paired-task benchmark built on an agent-native taxonomy of 8 abstention scenarios across pre-execution reasoning and runtime discovery. It contains 263 paired tasks across 42 executable sandbox environments, where each pair consists of a should-act task and a should-abstain variant produced through a controlled perturbation to the instruction, tool, or environment state. To scale this paired design and resist data contamination, we propose AbstainGen, a fully automated pipeline that synthesizes sandbox environments and generates paired tasks end-to-end, validated by deterministic replay and semantic LLM judges; fresh task instances can be regenerated on demand, and three independent annotators rate 94-98% of sampled tasks as well-designed. Across 17 frontier LLMs in 4 agent harnesses, the best agent (Gemini 3.1 Pro) achieves only 59.5% paired accuracy (correct on both the act and abstain sides of each paired task). More importantly, abstention capability is largely independent of general task-solving capability, indicating that scaling task-solving alone will not close this gap. We further identify failure modes such as post-hoc abstention, in which agents execute irreversible actions before recognizing abstention triggers. Our code and dataset are open-sourced at agentabstain.github.io.

</details>


### [485] [From ambiguous utterances to governed reuse classes: canonicalization, quotient invariance, and conditional decidability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10069)
*Cosimo Spera,Ray Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出在受治理领域中，语义缓存的重用应基于对话需求的数学商集（quotient）而非嵌入相似性启发式方法，通过三个精炼关系链（阅读同一性、解析同一性、重用同一性）定义可认证的查询键和答案空间，并证明了整个管道的可计算性、策略可接受性及有限信息回复下的终止性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统语义缓存仅依赖嵌入相似性阈值来判断两个话语是否可共享答案，缺乏对授权、版本控制以及"两个需求是否相同"的形式化定义。在受治理领域（governed domain）中，这种启发式方法无法保证答案重用的正确性和合规性，因此需要一种基于严格数学刻画的重用机制。

Method: 定义了三条独立的关系（阅读同一性、解析同一性、重用同一性）形成精炼链（refinement chain），在非退化条件下严格偏序；证明管道输出沿该链不变，且重用同一性恰为解析映射到受治理答案划分的核（kernel）；重用商（reuse quotient）是划分所诱导的话语侧对象，而非其重新标记。使用精确指称范式、连接聚合作为设计算子、闭包稳定单元刻画无逃逸性，在不可信提议层上实现全管道的完全可计算性。

Result: 重用同一性为受治理查询键及其可认证答案空间提供许可；特定答案的重用需解析同一性或适用性证书。整个管道在不可信提议层上完全可计算，策略对任意提议者均可接受（而非依赖于事实基础或意图保真度），且信息性回复在有限轮次内终止，在目标一致性条件下保持正确性。

Conclusion: 本文为受治理领域的语义缓存提供了一个严格的数学基础，将重用问题从启发式相似性转移到精确的商集构造上，在保证计算可行性的同时满足了治理需求。

Abstract: Semantic caching defines answer reuse on embedding similarity: two utterances share a stored answer when a similarity score clears a threshold, with no notion of authorization, versioning, or of what makes two demands the same. This note changes the object on which reuse is defined: in a governed domain, reuse should operate on a mathematically characterized quotient of resolved conversational demands, not on a similarity heuristic. Three independently defined relations on resolved utterances -- reading identity, resolution identity, and reuse identity -- form a refinement chain, strict under realized nondegeneracy conditions checkable on deployment logs; the pipeline's outputs are invariant along the chain, and reuse identity is exactly the kernel of the resolution map into the governed answer partition, so the reuse quotient is the utterance-side object that partition induces, not a relabeling of it. Reuse identity licenses the governed query key and its certified answer space; reuse of a particular answer requires resolution identity or an applicability certificate. The supporting layer is stated at exactly the strength proved: exact-denotation normal forms; join aggregation as a design operator, with closure-stable cells characterizing no-escape; total computability of the full pipeline relative to an untrusted proposal layer; policy admissibility for arbitrary proposers -- and provably not factual grounding or intent fidelity; and elicitation terminating after finitely many informative replies, sound under target consistency.

</details>


### [486] [MAG: A Web-Agent Benchmark and Harness for Multimodal Action and Guide Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10079)
*Chengguang Gan,Hanjun Wei,Yunhao Liang,Zhixi Cai,Qinghao Zhang,Shiwen Ni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MAG基准，首个统一多模态动作执行与引导文本生成的复合任务，包含两种截图级标注方案（Set-of-Mark元素选择和原始像素坐标），并构建了完整的评测框架（LLM辅助标注+人工验证、训练、在线评估、联合指标）。实验发现最优模型任务完成率不足40%，而提出的GRPO训练方法（结合专家轨迹）将9B监督模型的成功率从6.9%提升至13.2%，同时改善了引导质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将自动化网页代理操作与引导文本生成视为两个独立问题，且多数方法依赖DOM或可访问性树等文本化页面表示，而非人类实际操作的渲染截图。同时，真实任务往往涉及跨页面状态的多步序列操作，现有方法难以胜任。

Method: 1）提出MAG（Multimodal Action and Guide）基准，将任务执行与引导编写统一为复合任务；2）设计两种截图级标注方案：Set-of-Mark元素选择和原始像素坐标；3）构建完整评测框架（LLM辅助标注+人工验证、训练、在线评估、联合指标）；4）提出结合专家轨迹的GRPO训练方法。

Result: 最优API模型任务完成率低于40%；提出的GRPO训练方法将9B监督模型的成功率从6.9%提升至13.2%，同时提升了引导质量。

Conclusion: 当前最先进模型在多模态网页操作与引导任务上仍有巨大提升空间；将动作执行与引导生成联合训练有助于提升两者性能。

Abstract: Digital Adoption Platforms (DAPs) are embedded overlays widely used on web systems to guide users through operations inside a page, helping them get started with unfamiliar interfaces quickly. Completing a real task, however, rarely means clicking a few buttons on a single page: it takes a sequence of actions that unfolds across changing page states. Prior studies have also treated automated web agent actions and guide text generation as two separate problems, and most of them feed models textual page representations such as the DOM or accessibility trees rather than the rendered screens that humans actually operate on. In this work we introduce MAG, the first benchmark that unifies task execution and guide writing into a single Multimodal Action and Guide task, with two grounding schemes over screenshots: Set-of-Mark element selection and raw pixel coordinates. We further build a complete harness for this compound task, covering annotation with LLM assistance and human verification, training, evaluation in live environments, and joint metrics for actions and guides. With this harness we evaluate frontier API models and open multimodal models, and report detailed analyses. Finally, we design a GRPO training method augmented with expert trajectories, which nearly doubles the success rate of a supervised 9B agent (from 6.9% to 13.2%) and improves guide quality at the same time. Even the strongest model completes fewer than 40% of the tasks, leaving ample room for future research.

</details>


### [487] [Looped State-Space Language Models with Adaptive Exit-State Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10110)
*Zhenxuan Yu,Takeshi Kojima,Yutaka Matsuo,Yusuke Iwasawa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探索了循环状态空间模型（Looped Mamba和Looped Hybrid Mamba-Transformer）在推理任务和语言模型预训练中的表现，发现循环模型在参数共享下仍具竞争力，但深度非循环模型在严格等FLOPs比较中仍占优；同时引入自适应出口机制可提升中间层性能，但实际推理加速需额外状态处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明循环语言模型（looped LMs）可通过增加计算深度而非独立参数来提升推理能力，但现有工作几乎只关注Transformer架构，尚未验证该原则是否适用于状态空间语言模型。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 构建Looped Mamba和Looped Hybrid Mamba-Transformer架构，重复使用共享的Mamba（或混合）模块引入显式有限深度循环计算；在Mano（模算术操作）和p-hop归纳两类推理任务上进行评估；进一步在等参数和等FLOPs协议下进行语言模型预训练对比；并借鉴Ouro的两阶段出口门控机制实现自适应步长选择。

Result: 在推理任务中，Looped Mamba持续优于参数匹配的非循环基线，甚至在多个设置下匹配或超越等有效深度的非循环模型。在语言模型预训练中，循环模型以更少的独立参数在下游基准上保持竞争力，但严格等FLOPs下更深非循环模型在验证困惑度上仍占优。自适应出口选择在中间深度提升了下游性能。

Conclusion: 循环计算原则适用于状态空间模型，但参数共享与计算深度之间存在权衡；自适应出口机制可改善中间层性能，但实际推理加速需额外状态处理机制。

Abstract: Recent work on looped language models suggests that many reasoning problems benefit from greater computational depth rather than from additional independent parameters. Existing studies, however, focus almost exclusively on Transformer backbones, leaving open whether this principle also applies to state-space language models. We investigate Looped Mamba and Looped Hybrid Mamba-Transformer architectures, which repeatedly apply a shared Mamba (or hybrid) block to introduce explicit finite-depth recurrent computation. On two controlled reasoning tasks-Mano (modular-arithmetic manipulation) and p-hop induction-Looped Mamba consistently outperforms parameter-matched non-looped baselines and, in several settings, matches or exceeds non-looped models of equal effective depth. We then extend the study to language model pre-training under matched iso-parameter and iso-FLOPs protocols, which jointly disentangle the effects of parameter sharing and effective depth: looped models remain competitive on downstream benchmarks with substantially fewer distinct parameters, although deeper non-looped models retain an advantage in validation perplexity under strict iso-FLOPs comparisons. Finally, we adapt Ouro's two-stage exit gate to Looped Mamba for threshold-controlled selection among recurrent-step outputs. Since all recurrent steps are still executed, the selected exit step represents prediction depth rather than reduced wall-clock computation. At the scales studied, adaptive exit-state selection improves downstream performance at intermediate depths, while actual inference-time savings require additional state-handling mechanisms.

</details>


### [488] [Dynamic Agent Skills: A Lifecycle Survey and Taxonomy of Evolving Skill Libraries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10113)
*Yubo Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过124篇论文的系统综述，提出了一个以生命周期为核心的动态技能库分析框架，包含六感分类法区分技能类型、八阶段生命周期架构描述技能演化过程，以及十算子词汇表统一比较标准。研究发现准入与修复是关键环节、验证器质量显著影响技能感知强化学习、平面检索随库增长而退化，并指出当前基准在轨迹记录、效用差距和安全评估方面存在不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地在模型外部存储可复用的过程性知识（技能），但现有文献对"技能"的定义混乱，且缺乏统一框架来理解技能库如何随时间动态演化。作者旨在通过系统分类和生命周期视角，梳理并归纳这一新兴领域的设计决策与关键挑战。

Method: 对2023-2026年间124篇论文进行系统性综述，提出三个分析工具：1）六感分类法区分不同类型的技能制品；2）八阶段生命周期架构描述技能从证据获取到治理的完整演化过程；3）轻量级技能记录模式与十算子词汇表，为比较不同库的更新操作提供通用语言。

Result: 识别出技能库设计的重复性关键模式：准入与修复环节反复出现且重要；验证器的质量对技能感知强化学习有实质性影响；平面检索方法在库规模增大时会退化；当前基准在报告库轨迹、使用-效用差距和安全面方面存在系统性的报告不足。

Conclusion: 技能库应被视为动态演化的制品集合而非静态提示或工具集合，现有评估体系需要引入更严格的报告标准（如库轨迹记录、效用差距测量、安全评估），并提出若干开放问题供后续研究。

Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly store reusable procedures outside the model. These reusable procedures are often called \emph{skills}: they may be code functions, natural-language instructions, SKILL.md packages, workflow graphs, or learned adapters that a future agent can retrieve and invoke. This taxonomy-driven survey asks how such skill libraries change over time. Across a $124$-paper $2023$--$2026$ audit set, we synthesize dynamic skill systems as \emph{lifecycle-managed, verified, evolving artifact stores}: agents collect evidence from interaction, propose skill updates, verify and admit candidates, organize them for retrieval and composition, repair or prune stale entries, and govern sharing through provenance and rollback. We organize the literature around three survey tools. First, a $\text{six}$-sense taxonomy distinguishes the structurally different artifacts called ``skills'' in current papers. Second, an $\text{eight}$-stage lifecycle architecture identifies the recurring design decisions behind evidence acquisition, proposal, verification/admission, storage, retrieval/composition, maintenance, distillation/portability, and governance. Third, a lightweight skill-record schema and $\text{ten}$-operator vocabulary provide common terms for comparing library updates without elevating them into a separate method contribution. Using this structure, we synthesize evidence-graded patterns with explicit caveats: admission and repair are repeatedly important, verifier quality materially affects skill-aware RL, flat retrieval can degrade as libraries grow, and current benchmarks still under-report library trajectories, usage--utility gaps, and safety surfaces. We close with concrete reporting standards and open problems for evaluating dynamic skills as changing libraries rather than static prompt or tool collections.

</details>


### [489] [IdeaTrail: Full-Process Agent Trajectories for Scientific Ideation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10144)
*Hengquan Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了SciAgent，一个面向科学构思与提案生成的多轮过程轨迹数据集。每条记录从证据收集到想法选择或提案构建完整记录研究过程，采用从高质量论文和提案制品出发的生成器-顾问合成循环，生成与真实科学制品对齐的多轮研究数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有资源仅捕捉科学研究的单个环节，缺乏联合记录工具使用、证据获取、中间制品演化以及想法或提案层面终点的数据集，无法支持对完整多阶段科研流程（文献检索、论文阅读、工具使用、主张验证、跨论文综合、头脑风暴、弱方向淘汰、迭代写作）的研究与建模。

Method: 采用"反向-正向"合成流程：从人工筛选的高质量研究论文和提案制品出发，通过生成器-顾问（Generator-Advisor）合成循环构建轨迹。生成器产生可见轨迹（包含动作、观察和制品编辑），顾问拥有完整生成上下文，检查轨迹的接地性、因果顺序、自然性以及是否泄露隐藏目标。

Result: 构建了多轮过程轨迹数据集，每条实例记录从证据收集到想法选择或提案构建的完整研究过程，生成的数据与真实科学制品对齐，同时近似了科研实践中的不确定性、证据使用和阶段性收敛特征。

Conclusion: SciAgent不仅提供了数据集，还提供了一种通用的过程监督数据合成配方，可用于为科研智能体生成过程监督训练数据。

Abstract: Scientific research is a complex, multi-stage workflow rather than a single act of text generation. The ideation process typically emerges through literature search, paper reading, tool use, claim checking, cross-paper synthesis, brainstorming, rejection of weak directions, and iterative writing. Existing resources capture individual components of this process, but datasets that jointly record tool use, evidence acquisition, intermediate artifact evolution, and idea- or proposal-level endpoints remain limited. This report introduces \method, a multi-turn process-trajectory dataset for scientific ideation and proposal generation. Each instance records a research process from evidence gathering to either idea selection or proposal construction. Rather than freely fabricating trajectories, \method starts from human-selected high-quality research papers and proposal artifacts and uses a Generator--Advisor synthesis loop. The Generator produces the visible trajectory through actions, observations, and artifact edits, while the Advisor has access to the full generation context and checks grounding, causal order, naturalness, and leakage from hidden targets. This reverse-to-forward procedure produces multi-turn research data that remains aligned with real scientific artifacts while approximating the uncertainty, evidence use, and staged convergence of research practice. \method provides both a dataset and a general recipe for synthesizing process-supervision data for scientific research agents.

</details>


### [490] [UNIT: Unleash Large Language Models Potential for Graph Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10159)
*Tairan Huang,Yili Wang,Beibei Hu,Yiting Shi,Qiutong Li,Changlong He,Jianliang Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出UNIT框架，通过微调大语言模型、不确定性感知锚点生成机制和结构融合建模，解决了图持续学习中语义-结构分离和知识迁移不平衡的问题，在图持续学习任务上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图持续学习方法面临两大挑战：1) 语义-结构分离，图方法擅长建模拓扑关系但忽略深层语义；2) 知识迁移不平衡，模型无法有效利用早期任务学到的通用知识来帮助后续新任务。

Method: 1) 仅在第一个任务上微调LLM，弥合预训练语料与目标任务数据集的分布差距；2) 提出不确定性感知锚点生成机制，有效保留跨任务的代表性知识；3) 引入结构融合建模，将图拓扑信息显式整合到语义信息中。

Result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在图持续学习任务上达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 通过释放大语言模型在图持续学习中的潜力，UNIT框架有效解决了语义-结构分离和知识迁移不平衡问题，在多模态流式图数据场景下取得了优异表现。

Abstract: In real-world multimodal web scenarios, graph-structured data often arrives in a streaming manner, making graph continual learning a crucial paradigm for continuously modeling such evolving structures. However, existing graph continual learning methods still face two fundamental challenges. 1) semantic-structural separation, where the graph-based methods excel at modeling topological relationships but neglect deep semantics. 2) imbalanced knowledge transfer, where existing models fail to effectively leverage general knowledge gained from early tasks to benefit subsequent new tasks. To address above issues, we propose a novel framework, \textbf{UN}leash Large Language Models PotentIal for Graph ConTinual Learning (UNIT). By fine-tuning large language model only on the first task, we bridge the distributional gap between the pre-trained LLM corpus and the target task dataset to enhance the adaptability of LLMs for graph-structured tasks. Meanwhile, we propose an uncertain-aware anchor generation mechanism to effectively preserve representative knowledge across tasks, avoiding the neglect of universal knowledge learned from previous tasks. Additionally, we introduce structural confluence modeling to explicitly integrates graph topology information into semantic information, enhancing the collaborative capabilities between semantic understanding and structural modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance in the graph continual learning task.

</details>


### [491] [GRATE: Temporal Extensions for Inductive KG Foundation Models via Gated Rotary Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10197)
*Jiaxin Pan,Osama Mohammed,Daniel Hernández,Steffen Staab*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GRATE是一种无额外可学习参数的实体侧消息函数，通过旋转注意力机制编码相对时间差，使知识图谱基础模型能够实现时间知识图谱的跨数据集归纳迁移，并在新构建的归纳迁移基准上表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TKG模型参数与特定数据集实体、关系或时间戳绑定，无法迁移到词汇表不重叠的TKG上，而静态知识图谱基础模型（如Ultra、Trix）已实现强大的归纳迁移能力，因此需要将这种迁移性扩展到TKG领域。

Method: 提出GRATE（门控旋转注意力时序编码），一种无参数实体侧消息函数：通过相对时间差旋转边消息编码时间信息，并应用查询条件化门控选择时间相关信号。GRATE集成到NBFNet风格的KG基础模型中，保持结构迁移性。同时构建GDELTIndT和WIKIIndT两个归纳迁移基准套件，具有不重叠的实体、关系和时间戳。

Result: 在归纳迁移基准和留出法预测数据集上，单个联合预训练的GRATE检查点在大多数设置下优于静态基础模型。

Conclusion: GRATE成功实现了TKG的跨数据集时序归纳迁移，且无需引入额外可学习参数，为时序知识图谱基础模型的设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: Knowledge graph foundation models such as Ultra and Trix achieve strong inductive transfer by learning relation-graph representations that generalise to unseen entities and relations. Extending this transferability to temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) remains challenging: existing temporal models tie their parameters to dataset-specific entities, relations, or timestamps and are not designed to transfer to TKGs with disjoint vocabularies. We propose GRATE (Gated Rotary Attention for Temporal Encoding), an entity-side message function that adds no learnable parameters and encodes time through relative time differences by rotating each edge message according to its time gap to the query and applying a query-conditioned gate to select temporally relevant signals. GRATE integrates into NBFNet-style KG foundation models while preserving structural transferability. Existing TKG benchmarks evaluate within shared train/test vocabularies and cannot directly test cross-dataset temporal transfer; we therefore construct GDELTIndT and WIKIIndT, inductive transfer benchmark suites with disjoint entities, relations, and timestamps spanning both interpolation and extrapolation. Across these benchmarks and held-out forecasting datasets, a single jointly pretrained GRATE checkpoint improves over the static base model in most settings.

</details>


### [492] [KGCQual: An Interpretable Framework for Evaluating the Knowledge Graph Construction Quality from Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10212)
*Nipun Misra,Vikranth Udandarao,Aanchal Gupta,Yogender Kumar,Manuj Mukherjee,Raghava Mutharaju*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为KGCQual的可解释内在知识图谱质量评估指标，通过实体级和关系级两个互补组件衡量自动抽取图与源文本表示"理想图"之间的结构语义保真度，实验证明该指标能可靠识别现有方法忽视的遗漏、冗余和结构偏差，并与下游链路预测性能显著相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识图谱质量评估依赖任务特定指标或小规模人工验证，缺乏对抽取图结构语义保真度的深入洞察，亟需一种标准化、可解释且模型无关的内在质量评估框架。

Method: 提出KGCQual框架，包含两个互补组件：(1) 实体级评估——评价完整性、解析质量和连通性；(2) 关系级评估——使用词汇相似度、依赖解析对齐和轻量级否定处理判断谓词保留度和多重性，衡量语义忠实度。

Result: 在WebNLG、TinyButMighty、BenchIE等多个数据集和多种SOTA三元组抽取系统上验证，该指标能可靠识别遗漏、冗余和结构偏差；消融实验分离名词和动词组件；下游评估表明KGCQual分数与链路预测性能显著相关。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可扩展、模型无关且可解释的框架用于比较自动KG构建方法，为标准化评估奠定了基础。

Abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are increasingly constructed through automated extraction pipelines; however, such systems often introduce spurious or incomplete triples, which degrade downstream performance. Existing evaluation practices rely heavily on task-specific metrics or small-scale manual verification, offering limited insight into the structural and semantic fidelity of extracted graphs. We propose a novel, interpretable metric for intrinsic KG quality assessment that measures how closely an automatically extracted graph approximates an "ideal" graph capturing the key noun phrases, predicate relations, and basic linguistic phenomena such as negation expressed in the source text. Our framework integrates two complementary components: (1) an entity-level assessment that evaluates completeness, resolution quality, and connectivity, and (2) a relation-level assessment that judges predicate preservation and multiplicity using lexical similarity, dependency-parse alignment, and light-weight negation handling to ensure semantic faithfulness. We evaluate our metric across multiple state-of-the-art triple extraction systems and datasets, including WebNLG, TinyButMighty, and BenchIE, demonstrating that it reliably identifies omissions, redundancy, and structural deviations that existing metrics overlook. Our work offers a scalable, model-agnostic, and interpretable framework for comparing automated KG construction methods and provides a foundation for standardised evaluation. We further validate the metric through an ablation study isolating noun and verb components, and a downstream evaluation showing that KGCQual scores correlate significantly with link prediction performance on the same extracted KGs. The code repository is available at https://github.com/kracr/kg-quality-metric.

</details>


### [493] [When Are Sparse Feature Interventions Actually Localized? Matched Evaluation for SAE-Based Safety Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10226)
*Daming Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文评估了稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征作为安全相关行为局部控制手柄的有效性，通过引入匹配一致性门控评估协议，发现SAE特征消融仅在窄范围内有效，且有用区间由少数拒绝对齐特征驱动，表明SAE安全干预应被视为状态依赖的控制机制而非均匀局部化的工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究声称SAE特征可以作为局部化控制手柄用于安全干预，但实际评估中常因弱干预、基线不匹配、模型鲁棒性或退化输出等问题导致虚假成功信号。需要更严格的评估框架来区分真实的安全控制效果与伪影。

Method: 提出匹配一致性门控评估协议：在匹配目标效应点比较不同方法，主要指标仅统计同时被法官判定不安全且输出连贯的有害遵从行为。在Gemma-2-9B-it上使用Gemma Scope层20残差SAE，在三种提示分割上测试SAE top800/1600/3200特征消融，并与密集拒绝方向基线对比，辅以人工审计和特征诊断分析。

Result: SAE top800在低到中等目标效应下具有较低总扰动和竞争性效用；SAE top1600相对于密集拒绝方向基线失去效用；SAE top3200主要导致连贯性崩溃。一致性门控有效去除了不安全-only伪影，有用区间由少数拒绝对齐特征驱动，其特征激活分离度随排名急剧衰减。

Conclusion: SAE特征消融作为安全干预手段仅在窄参数范围内有效，不应假定其具有均匀局部化的控制能力，而应将其视为状态依赖的控制机制进行评估。

Abstract: We evaluate when sparse autoencoder (SAE) features act as localized control handles for safety-relevant behavior. This question is difficult because apparent success can arise from weak interventions, mismatched baselines, model robustness, or degenerate outputs that automated safety judges mark as unsafe without representing meaningful harmful compliance. We introduce a matched coherence-gated evaluation protocol for runtime safety interventions: methods are compared at matched target-effect points, and the primary target metric counts harmful compliance only when an output is both judge-unsafe and coherent. Applying this protocol to three prompt splits on Gemma-2-9B-it with a Gemma Scope layer-20 residual SAE, we find that SAE feature ablation has a narrow useful regime. SAE top800 reaches a low-to-mid target effect with lower total perturbation and competitive utility, but SAE top1600 loses utility relative to a matched dense refusal-direction baseline, and SAE top3200 primarily induces coherence collapse. Human audit confirms that coherence gating removes unsafe-only artifacts, and feature diagnostics show that the useful regime is driven by a stable head of refusal-aligned features whose activation separation decays rapidly with rank. These results argue that SAE-based safety interventions should be evaluated as regime-dependent control mechanisms rather than assumed to be uniformly localized.

</details>


### [494] [Behavioural Signatures of Risk-Sensitive Decision-Making in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10251)
*Xuankun Rong,Wenke Huang,Bo Du,Dacheng Tao,Mang Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过无限制德州扑克框架，系统研究了LLM在不确定性决策中的风险行为模式，发现前沿LLM展现出稳定且模型特定的风险偏好，并在不同对手和压力条件下表现出异质性调整策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多用于决策支持，但它们在不确定性下的选择是否具有稳定和可解释的行为规律尚不清楚。人类决策结合了相对持久的风险偏好与情境依赖的调整，而LLM是否具有类似的行为结构有待探究。

Method: 基于无限制德州扑克构建受控多模型框架，通过"参与度"（衡量自愿参与不确定机会）和"主动性"（衡量翻牌前风险升级）量化行为。在同类自博弈和异类混合交互两种场景下进行实验，并施加全局风险压力和个人资源约束。

Result: 前沿LLM展现出稳定且模型特定的风险轮廓，形成从保守到激进的决策风格光谱。这些轮廓在对手构成变化时保持稳健，但最保守和最激进的模型在混合环境中分化加剧。在压力条件下，模型表现出从广泛行为收缩到选择性降级再到近乎不变行为的异质性适应。

Conclusion: LLM不仅在基线风险倾向上存在差异，还在所响应的风险信号和调整灵活性上有所不同，这为交互环境下风险敏感决策审计提供了行为学基础。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in decision support, it is important to understand whether their choices under uncertainty exhibit stable and interpretable behavioural regularities. Human decision-making combines relatively persistent risk preferences with context-dependent adjustment, yet it remains unclear whether analogous behavioural structure can be observed in LLM-based decision systems. Here we examine this question using a controlled multi-model framework based on no-limit Texas Hold'em, where behaviour is quantified by Participation, measuring voluntary engagement in uncertain opportunities, and Proactiveness, measuring pre-flop risk escalation. Across homogeneous self-play and heterogeneous mixed-model interactions, frontier LLMs exhibit stable, model-specific risk profiles, forming a spectrum from conservative to aggressive decision styles. These profiles remain largely robust under changing opponent composition, while the most conservative and most aggressive models diverge further in mixed settings. Under global risk pressure and personal resource constraint, models adapt in structured but heterogeneous ways, ranging from broad behavioural contraction to selective de-escalation and near-invariant behaviour. These findings suggest that LLMs differ not only in baseline risk disposition, but also in the risk signals they respond to and the flexibility with which they adjust, providing a behavioural basis for auditing risk-sensitive decision-making in interactive settings. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/XuankunRong/AgentTexasPoker.

</details>


### [495] [Information-seeking failures of large language models in agentic clinical reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10275)
*Krischan Braitsch,Laura K. Schmalbrock,Theresa Weltermann,Andrew F. Berdel,Isabella Miller,Kai Tran,Michael Heider,Sabrina Kraus,Florian Bassermann,Jacqueline Lammert,Sebastian Ziegelmayer,Marcus Makowski,Lisa C. Adams,Keno K. Bressem*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 当前最先进的大语言模型在血液肿瘤学临床推理中，核心瓶颈并非医学知识不足，而是在不确定性下主动寻求信息的系统性失败。模型最佳准确率仅68%，且信息利用率随轮次骤降，与诊断准确率强相关（R=0.69），而推理轨迹的局部合理性与全局正确性严重脱钩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估多聚焦于静态医学知识问答，无法反映临床实践中在不确定性下主动决策并寻求信息的关键能力。作者旨在构建更接近真实临床场景的评估框架，量化模型在信息寻求行为上的缺陷。

Method: 开发血液肿瘤学的智能体评估框架，要求模型在三个连续轮次中主动请求临床数据，随后做出诊断和治疗决策。在32个前沿模型上评估，分析信息利用率与诊断准确率的关系，并结合临床推理量表和错误分析诊断认知偏差。

Result: 最佳模型整体准确率仅68%；信息利用率与准确率强相关（R=0.69, P<0.001）；利用率从首轮57%骤降至末轮26%；推理轨迹与准确率去相关；错误模式主要为搜索满意化、锚定和过早闭合——与新手临床医生的认知偏差一致。

Conclusion: 当前LLM在临床肿瘤学中的主要限制不是医学知识不足，而是不确定性下信息寻求行为的系统性失败，揭示了局部推理连贯性与全局正确性之间的根本脱节。

Abstract: Large language models achieve high scores on medical knowledge assessments, yet clinical reasoning requires actively deciding what to investigate under uncertainty. We developed an agentic evaluation framework in hematologic oncology in which models must proactively request clinical data across three sequential rounds before committing to a diagnosis and treatment plan. Across 32 frontier models, the best achieved only 68% overall accuracy. Information utilization, the fraction of available data actually requested, was the strongest predictor of diagnostic accuracy (R = 0.69, P < 0.001), yet utilization collapsed from 57% to 26% in the final round, leaving molecular and cytogenetic data critical for treatment selection unexamined. Reasoning traces scored high on a clinical reasoning rubric (91% above threshold) but decorrelated from accuracy, revealing a gap between locally coherent rationales and globally correct conclusions. Error analysis identified search satisficing, anchoring and premature closure as the dominant failure modes, the same cognitive biases that characterize novice clinicians under dual-process models of diagnostic reasoning. These findings demonstrate that the primary limitation of current models in clinical oncology is not insufficient medical knowledge but a systematic failure of information-seeking under uncertainty.

</details>


### [496] [Can Agentic Trading Systems Pay for Their Own Intelligence?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10286)
*Qiqi Duan,Changlun Li,Chen Wang,Fan Zhang,Mengxiang Wang,Dayi Miao,Peixian Ma,Jiangpeng Yan,Liyuan Chen,Shuoling Liu,Preslav Nakov,Yuyu Luo,Nan Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TradeLens是一个基于轨迹的诊断工具包，用于评估LLM交易代理是否将智能转化为实际利润，而非仅关注性能指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估通常报告性能指标，但很少考察代理的可行性：即动态LLM决策能否将其诱导成本转化为可测量的增量利润。

Method: 提出TradeLens诊断工具包，通过交易记录、运行时轨迹和部署配置重建交易轨迹，将利润和成本归因于可解释证据，诊断代理是否为其智能付费。

Result: 可行性取决于智能到利润的转化；不同模型存在不同失败模式（如DeepSeek-V3.2资产选择差、GLM-4.7负择时）；资本规模、交易频率和架构仅通过放大或削弱决策归因的择时价值起作用。

Conclusion: 将LLM交易代理的评估从以能力为中心的性能排名转向基于轨迹的智能-利润转化诊断。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used in trading systems, where model reasoning, tool use, and continual decisions incur costs that are expected to produce trading value. Existing evaluations typically report performance metrics, but rarely examine agentic viability: whether dynamic LLM-mediated decisions convert their induced costs into measurable incremental profit. To apply this criterion, we introduce TradeLens, a trace-grounded diagnostic toolkit for evaluating agentic trading systems from their trading records, runtime traces, and deployment configurations. It reconstructs trading trajectories, attributes profit and cost to interpretable evidence, and diagnoses whether and why an agent pays for its own intelligence. We conduct extensive analysis across backbone models, capital scales, trading frequencies, and system architectures, together with deployment discussion.
